failed.question:
A man was charged with embezzling a large sum of money from a company account and consulted with an attorney. After the attorney agreed to take the case, her legal assistant called the man to discuss a fee arrangement and asked the man to make a large payment to place into escrow, which he did. The attorney then retained a forensic accountant to review financial statements released by the prosecution during discovery. In doing so, the forensic accountant met with the man and privately discussed the statements in the attorney's office.
The prosecution subpoenaed both the legal assistant and the forensic accountant to testify at trial. Each has refused to answer any questions concerning their respective conversations with the man, citing the attorney-client privilege.
To whom does this privilege apply?

Police received a tip from an informant that a man that lived on his street might be dealing drugs out of his home. An investigation was initiated in response to the informant's tip. During the investigation, an undercover officer purchased cocaine from the man at his home on multiple occasions. Police ultimately obtained a valid warrant to search the man's home and, while executing the warrant, found a large quantity of cocaine. The man was subsequently charged with knowingly possessing cocaine with the intent to distribute.
Prior to trial, the man requested disclosure of the identity of the informant and the contents of the informant's statement to police. The prosecutor refused to disclose the informant's identity and the substance of the informant's statement to police, claiming that both are privileged.
How should the court rule on the prosecutor's privilege claims?

A defendant has been charged with sexual exploitation of children after several images depicting the defendant's young daughter engaged in sexual conduct were found on a flash drive in his garage. The defendant has pleaded not guilty, claiming that the flash drive belonged to someone else.
At the jury trial in federal district court, the prosecutor seeks to call the defendant's wife, the child's stepmother, to testify that the defendant privately told her that he was likely "going away for a long time for what he did" and that "it would be best for protective services to remove their child from the home immediately." The wife has agreed to testify but the defendant has objected, citing spousal privilege.
Is the wife's proposed testimony admissible?

After a night of drinking at a bar, a man and his friend got into an argument over a sports team. The man became so upset that he punched the friend, breaking the friend's nose. The man was arrested for battery. The friend subsequently filed a civil action against the man for battery. In an attempt to dispose of both the criminal charge and the civil suit, the man offered to settle the civil suit with the friend for $10,000 if the friend would refuse to testify against the man in his criminal trial for battery. The friend declined and later informed the prosecutor of the man's offer. The prosecutor then filed an additional charge of obstruction of justice against the man.
Is the man's offer admissible at his trial for obstruction of justice?

questions.question:
A woman sued a car manufacturer alleging that she was seriously injured when a defect in her car's engine caused it to seize while the car was in motion. The manufacturer's chief engineer prepared a report on the engine's production history and failure rate at the request of the manufacturer's attorney in preparation for trial. The report was then delivered to the attorney. The woman demands that the report be produced during discovery.
Will production of the report be required?

choices.a: No, because it is a privileged attorney-client communication.
choices.b: No, because the report contains hearsay.
choices.c: No, because the report is self-serving.
choices.d: Yes, because business reports are not privileged.

A woman sued a car manufacturer alleging that she was seriously injured when a defect in her car's engine caused it to seize while the car was in motion. The manufacturer's chief engineer prepared a report on the engine's production history and failure rate at the request of the manufacturer's attorney in preparation for trial. The report was then delivered to the attorney. The woman demands that the report be produced during discovery.

Will production of the report be required?

一名女性起诉一家汽车制造商，指称因其汽车发动机存在缺陷，导致车辆在行驶中熄火，致其本人受到严重伤害。该制造商的总工程师应其律师的要求，为准备庭审，就该发动机的生产历史和故障率准备了一份报告。该报告随后被递交给律师。该女性要求在证据开示程序中出示该报告。

是否必须出示该报告？
options:
A. No, because it is a privileged attorney-client communication.
不会，因为该报告属于受特权保护的律师-当事人之间的沟通。

B. No, because the report contains hearsay.
不会，因为该报告包含传闻证据。

C. No, because the report is self-serving.
不会，因为该报告是利己的。

D. Yes, because business reports are not privileged.
会，因为商业报告不受特权保护。
data.explanation:
Common law privileges


Attorney-clientCommunications between client & attorney made to secure legal advice or representation

Client holds privilege forever - even after client is no longer represented or dies
Work productMaterials prepared by or for attorney in preparation for litigation
SpousalMarital communications - communications between spouses during marriage

Both spouses hold privilege - even after marriage has ended

Spousal immunity - shields spouse from testifying against criminal defendant-spouse about events that occurred beforeor during marriage

Witness-spouse holds privilege until marriage ends
Psychotherapist-patientCommunications between psychotherapist (or clinical social worker) & patient made for diagnosis or treatment for mental or emotional condition

Patient holds privilege & psychotherapist must assert in patient's absence
ReligiousCommunications between clergy member & penitent

Penitent holds privilege & clergy member must assert in penitent's absence
†Federal courts apply common law privileges except in diversity cases where state rules apply.

During discovery, a party may request production of information that relates to any issue in the lawsuit (eg, the identity of witnesses). But the opposing party is not required to produce privileged information, like communications protected by the attorney-client privilege. This privilege applies to: communications between a client and an attorney that were made for the purpose of securing legal advice or representation and were intended to be and kept confidential.

Here, the manufacturer's chief engineer prepared and delivered a report at the request of the manufacturer's attorney (communication). The woman then demanded production of that report during discovery. But the report is privileged because it was created in preparation for trial (to secure legal advice) and there is no indication that it was shared with anyone other than the manufacturer's attorney (confidential). Therefore, production is not required.

(Choice B) The report may contain hearsay - ie, out-of-court statements offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. But this would only affect the report's admissibility at trial - not immunize it from production.

(Choice C) The report may be self-serving if it only contains information that is helpful to the manufacturer's defense. But since a party may request any information that relates to the lawsuit, the fact that the report may be self-serving is not a basis for withholding it from production.

(Choice D) Business reports made for the purpose of securing legal advice are privileged if they were (1) intended to be and kept confidential and (2) communicated between a member of the company and its legal counsel.

Educational objective: The attorney-client privilege applies to (1) communications between a client and an attorney that (2) were made to secure legal advice or representation and (3) were intended to be and kept confidential. As a result, such communications need not be produced during discovery or at trial.

选项正确率统计：A选项 65%（正确选项），B选项 4%，C选项 4%，D选项 25%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

普通法上的特权


律师-当事人特权为获取法律建议或代理而在当事人与律师之间进行的沟通

当事人永久持有该特权——即使在代理关系结束后或当事人去世后
工作成果特权律师为准备诉讼而准备的或为其准备的材料
配偶特权婚姻内沟通——婚姻关系存续期间配偶之间的沟通

夫妻双方均持有该特权——即使在婚姻关系结束后

配偶豁免权——保护配偶免于就婚姻关系存续之前或期间发生的事件作证，指控其刑事被告人配偶

证人配偶持有该特权，直至婚姻关系结束
心理治疗师-患者特权为诊断或治疗精神或情绪状况，在心理治疗师（或临床社工）与患者之间进行的沟通

患者持有该特权，且心理治疗师必须在患者缺席时主张该特权
宗教特权神职人员与忏悔者之间的沟通

忏悔者持有该特权，且神职人员必须在忏悔者缺席时主张该特权
†联邦法院适用普通法上的特权，但在多样性管辖权案件中，适用州法律规则。

在证据开示程序中，一方当事人可以要求出示与诉讼中任何争议点相关的信息（例如，证人的身份）。但对方当事人无需出示受特权保护的信息，例如受律师-当事人特权保护的沟通。该特权适用于：为了获取法律建议或代理而进行的、并且意图保密且保持机密的当事人与律师之间的沟通。

在本案中，制造商的总工程师应其律师的要求准备并递交了一份报告（沟通）。该女性随后要求在证据开示程序中出示该报告。但该报告受到特权保护，因为它是为准备庭审（以获取法律建议）而创建的，并且没有迹象表明除制造商的律师外，该报告曾与任何其他人分享（保密）。因此，无需出示该报告。

（选项 B）该报告可能包含传闻证据——即，为证明其所主张事项的真实性而提出的庭外陈述。但这只会影响该报告在庭审中的可采性——而不会使其免于出示。

（选项 C）如果该报告仅包含对制造商辩护有利的信息，它可能被认为是利己的。但由于一方当事人可以要求提供与诉讼相关的任何信息，报告可能是利己的这一事实，并不能构成拒绝出示的理由。

（选项 D）为获取法律建议而制作的商业报告，如果（1）意图保密且保持机密，以及（2）是在公司成员与其法律顾问之间进行的沟通，那么它们是受特权保护的。

教学目标：律师-当事人特权适用于（1）当事人与律师之间的沟通，该沟通（2）是为了获取法律建议或代理而进行的，且（3）意图保密并保持机密。因此，此类沟通无需在证据开示程序中或庭审时出示。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence & Civil Procedure

⚖️ 核心考点

律师-当事人特权 (Attorney-Client Privilege) 在公司环境下的适用范围，以及其在证据开示 (Discovery) 阶段的保护作用。

📝 案情简述

汽车制造商被起诉。为了准备庭审 (Preparation for trial)，律师要求总工程师撰写一份关于发动机故障率的报告。原告要求在证据开示阶段获取这份报告。

✅ 正确答案：A

不需要出示，因为它是受特权保护的律师-当事人沟通。

法律依据与推理：

在联邦证据规则下，律师-当事人特权 (Attorney-Client Privilege) 保护以下要素：

  1. 沟通 (Communication)： 必须是信息交流。
  2. 双方 (Between Attorney and Client)： 在律师与当事人之间。
  3. 目的 (Purpose)： 为了获取或提供法律建议 (Legal Advice)。
  4. 保密性 (Confidentiality)： 意图保密且实际保持机密。

在公司背景下 (Corporate Context)：
根据 Upjohn Co. v. United States 确立的原则，当公司员工（如本案的总工程师）应上级或法律顾问的要求，就其职责范围内的事项与公司律师沟通，以便公司获取法律建议时，该沟通受特权保护。

本案中，报告是工程师应律师要求、为准备庭审而制作并交付给律师的。这构成了为了法律目的的保密沟通，因此原告无权在 Discovery 中要求出示。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 B (传闻 Hearsay)：
考点陷阱：可采性 vs. 可发现性
"传闻"是庭审时 (At Trial) 的证据排除规则。在证据开示 (Discovery) 阶段，只要信息与案件相关且不涉及特权，即使它将来在庭审中不可采（Inadmissible），也必须出示。因此，包含传闻不是拒绝出示的理由。

选项 C (利己 Self-serving)：
证据是否"利己"与是否必须出示无关。Discovery 的目的是挖掘所有相关事实，无论好坏。

选项 D (商业报告 Business Reports)：
关键区别：日常业务 vs. 诉讼准备
普通的商业记录（如日常维护日志）通常不受保护。但本报告是专门为诉讼准备 (Prepared in anticipation of litigation) 并提交给律师的。这使其脱离了普通商业记录的范畴，进入了特权或工作成果 (Work Product) 的保护范围。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

遇到要求出示文件 (Production of Documents) 的题目时，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 是特权沟通吗？ (Attorney-Client Privilege) —— 绝对保护。
  2. 是工作成果吗？ (Work Product) —— 通常保护，除非对方有特殊需求 (Substantial Need) 和无法获取的困难 (Undue Hardship)。
  3. 仅仅是不可采吗？ (如 Hearsay) —— 必须出示。Discovery 的范围远宽于 Admissibility。

本题中，报告既是特权沟通也是工作成果，因此绝对不需要出示。

questions.question:
A pedestrian sued a driver for personal injuries sustained when the driver's car hit the pedestrian. Immediately after the accident, the driver got out of his car, raced over to the pedestrian, and said, "Don't worry, I'll pay your hospital bill."
Is the pedestrian's testimony concerning the driver's statement admissible to prove the driver's liability?

choices.a: No, because it is an offer to pay medical expenses.
choices.b: No, provided that the driver kept his promise to pay the pedestrian's medical expenses.
choices.c: Yes, because it is an admission of liability by a party-opponent.
choices.d: Yes, because it is within the excited utterance exception to the hearsay rule.

data.questionStem:
Q87137

A pedestrian sued a driver for personal injuries sustained when the driver's car hit the pedestrian. Immediately after the accident, the driver got out of his car, raced over to the pedestrian, and said, "Don't worry, I'll pay your hospital bill."

Is the pedestrian's testimony concerning the driver's statement admissible to prove the driver's liability?

一名行人因被一名司机的汽车撞倒而遭受人身伤害，遂起诉该司机。事故发生后，司机立即下车，跑到行人身边说：“别担心，我会付你的医疗费。”

为证明司机的责任，该行人关于司机陈述的证词是否可被采纳？
options:
A. No, because it is an offer to pay medical expenses.
不可采纳，因为这是支付医疗费用的要约。

B. No, provided that the driver kept his promise to pay the pedestrian's medical expenses.
不可采纳，前提是司机遵守了其支付行人医疗费用的承诺。

C. Yes, because it is an admission of liability by a party-opponent.
可采纳，因为这是诉讼对方当事人对责任的承认。

D. Yes, because it is within the excited utterance exception to the hearsay rule.
可采纳，因为这属于传闻证据规则中的“激动言辞”例外情形。
data.explanation:
Offer of compromise v. Offer to pay medical expenses


AdmissibilityRationale
Offer of compromise
(FRE 408)		Inadmissible to:
prove/disprove validity of disputed claim or impeach party through prior inconsistent statement or contradiction		Settlement of disputes
Offer to pay medical expenses
(FRE 409)		Always inadmissible to prove liability for injuryAssistance to injured persons
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence

Under Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 409, evidence that a party has paid or offered to pay medical, hospital, or similar expenses resulting from an injury is inadmissible to prove liability for that injury. Therefore, the pedestrian's testimony concerning the driver's statement is inadmissible to prove the driver's liability.

(Choice B) A promise to pay medical expenses is inadmissible to prove liability for an injury even if the offering party kept that promise.

(Choice C) A party-opponent's statement is excluded from the rule against hearsay when offered against that party (ie, is nonhearsay). But here, since the driver's nonhearsay statement was an offer to pay the pedestrian's medical expenses, it is inadmissible under FRE 409.

(Choice D) The excited utterance hearsay exception applies to statements (1) relating to a startling event or condition and (2) made while the declarant was under the stress of excitement caused by that event or condition. Here, no hearsay exception is necessary since the driver's statement is nonhearsay. But even if the statement fell within this exception, it would still be inadmissible under FRE 409.

Educational objective: Evidence that a party has paid or offered to pay medical, hospital, or similar expenses resulting from an injury is inadmissible to prove liability for that injury.

选项正确率统计：A选项 90%（正确选项），B选项 0%，C选项 6%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

和解要约 vs. 支付医疗费用的要约


可采纳性基本原理
和解要约
(FRE 408)		不可采纳用于：
证明或反驳争议请求的有效性或通过先前不一致的陈述或矛盾来弹劾当事人		解决争议
支付医疗费用的要约
(FRE 409)		始终不可采纳用于证明伤害责任援助伤者
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence (联邦证据规则)

根据《联邦证据规则》(FRE) 第409条，一方当事人已支付或要约支付因伤害而产生的医疗、住院或类似费用的证据，不可采纳用于证明该伤害的责任。因此，行人关于司机陈述的证词不可采纳用于证明司机的责任。

（选项B） 即使要约方遵守了支付医疗费用的承诺，该承诺亦不可采纳用于证明伤害责任。

（选项C） 当诉讼对方当事人的陈述被用作对其不利的证据时，该陈述不适用反传闻规则（即非传闻证据）。但在本案中，由于司机的非传闻证据陈述是支付行人医疗费用的要约，根据FRE第409条，该陈述不可采纳。

（选项D） 传闻证据的激动言辞例外适用于以下陈述：（1）与惊人事件或状况有关；（2）陈述人在该事件或状况引起的激动压力下作出。在本案中，由于司机的陈述是非传闻证据，因此无需适用传闻证据的例外情形。但即使该陈述符合此例外情形，根据FRE第409条，它仍然不可采纳。

教学目的： 一方当事人已支付或要约支付因伤害而产生的医疗、住院或类似费用的证据，不可采纳用于证明该伤害的责任。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 409 (offers to pay medical expenses).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法)
⚖️ 核心规则：FRE 409

Payment of Medical and Similar Expenses (支付医疗及类似费用)

根据《联邦证据规则》第 409 条，提供、承诺支付或实际支付因伤害导致的医疗、住院或类似费用的证据，不可采纳 (Inadmissible) 用于证明该伤害的责任 (Liability)。

为什么选 A？

本题考查的是公共政策排除规则 (Public Policy Exclusions)。

司机说："Don't worry, I'll pay your hospital bill."（别担心，我会付你的医疗费。）

这句话是一个典型的支付医疗费用的要约 (Offer to pay medical expenses)。法律为了鼓励人们在他人受伤时伸出援手（人道主义行为），规定此类善意的要约不能在法庭上被用来作为承认错误的证据。

因此，无论该陈述是否符合传闻证据 (Hearsay) 的例外，它首先被 FRE 409 直接排除，不能用于证明责任。

🎓 MBE 进阶：FRE 408 vs. 409

这是 MBE 考试中极易混淆的两个规则，请务必区分：

规则 FRE 408
和解要约 (Compromise)		 FRE 409
医疗费 (Medical Exp.)
前提 必须存在争议 (Dispute)（关于责任或金额） 不需要存在争议
保护范围 保护要约以及谈判过程中的所有陈述 (Conduct or statements) 仅保护支付费用的要约/行为本身
附带承认 ✓ 同时也排除 ✗ 不排除（可采纳）

⚠️ 关键区别：如果在支付医疗费的要约中夹杂了事实承认（例如：“是我闯红灯了，我会付医药费”），根据 FRE 409：

  • “我会付医药费” → 不可采纳
  • “是我闯红灯了” → 可采纳 (Admissible)

但在本题中，司机只说了要付钱，没有承认具体过错，所以整句话都不可采纳。

为什么其他选项错误？

选项 C (Admission) 和 D (Excited Utterance)：

这两个选项试图用传闻证据规则 (Hearsay Rule) 来解决问题。虽然司机的陈述确实属于“对方当事人陈述”(Party-Opponent Statement) 或者是“激动言辞”(Excited Utterance)，在传闻规则层面通常是可采纳的。

但是！证据的可采纳性必须通过所有关卡。即使通过了传闻规则这一关，它被 FRE 409 (相关性/政策排除) 这一关拦下了。政策性排除规则优先于传闻例外。

选项 B (Condition)：

FRE 409 的排除规则是绝对的，不取决于承诺是否被履行。

解题口诀：
看到 "Pay Medical Bill" → 想到 FRE 409。
只排除 "Pay" 的部分，不排除 "Fault" 的承认。
(本题只有 Pay，所以全排除)

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant for damages for physical injuries allegedly caused by the defendant's violation of the federal civil rights law. The incident occurred wholly within State A, but the case was tried in federal court. The State A code says, "The common law privileges are preserved intact in this state."
At trial, the defendant called the plaintiff's physician to testify to confidential statements made to her by the plaintiff in furtherance of his medical treatment for the injuries allegedly caused by the defendant. The plaintiff objects, claiming a physician-patient privilege.
What law applies here and how should the court rule on the plaintiff's privilege claim?

choices.a: Federal law applies and the court should recognize the plaintiff's claim of privilege.
choices.b: Federal law applies and the court should reject the plaintiff's claim of privilege.
choices.c: State law applies and the court should recognize the plaintiff's claim of privilege.
choices.d: State law applies and the court should reject the claim of privilege.

data.questionStem:
Q87142

A plaintiff sued a defendant for damages for physical injuries allegedly caused by the defendant's violation of the federal civil rights law. The incident occurred wholly within State A, but the case was tried in federal court. The State A code says, "The common law privileges are preserved intact in this state."

At trial, the defendant called the plaintiff's physician to testify to confidential statements made to her by the plaintiff in furtherance of his medical treatment for the injuries allegedly caused by the defendant. The plaintiff objects, claiming a physician-patient privilege.

What law applies here and how should the court rule on the plaintiff's privilege claim?

一名原告因被告涉嫌违反联邦民权法而造成的身体伤害，向被告提起损害赔偿诉讼。该事件完全发生在A州境内，但案件在联邦法院进行审理。A州法典规定：“普通法上的特免权在本州完整保留。”

在庭审中，被告传唤原告的医生，就原告为治疗其据称由被告造成的伤害而向医生作出的保密陈述作证。原告提出异议，主张医生-患者特免权。

本案应适用何种法律，法院应如何对原告的特免权主张作出裁定？
options:
A. Federal law applies and the court should recognize the plaintiff's claim of privilege.
适用联邦法，法院应承认原告的特免权主张。

B. Federal law applies and the court should reject the plaintiff's claim of privilege.
适用联邦法，法院应驳回原告的特免权主张。

C. State law applies and the court should recognize the plaintiff's claim of privilege.
适用州法，法院应承认原告的特免权主张。

D. State law applies and the court should reject the claim of privilege.
适用州法，法院应驳回原告的特免权主张。

Common law privileges


Attorney-clientCommunications between client & attorney made to secure legal advice or representation

Client holds privilege forever - even after client is no longer represented or dies
Work productMaterials prepared by or for attorney in preparation for litigation
SpousalMarital communications - communications between spouses during marriage
Both spouses hold privilege - even after marriage has ended

Spousal immunity - shields spouse from testifying against criminal defendant-spouse about events that occurred beforeor during marriage
Witness-spouse holds privilege until marriage ends
Psychotherapist-patientCommunications between psychotherapist (or clinical social worker) & patient made for diagnosis or treatment for mental or emotional condition

Patient holds privilege & psychotherapist must assert in patient's absence
ReligiousCommunications between clergy member & penitent

Penitent holds privilege & clergy member must assert in penitent's absence
†Federal courts apply common law privileges except in diversity cases where state rules apply.

When a claim arises under federal law (eg, a federal civil rights law), federal law applies to both substantive and procedural issues. As a result, the court should only recognize the plaintiff's claim of privilege if it involves a federal common law privilege (Choices C & D). And since there is no physician-patient privilege under federal law, the court should reject the plaintiff's claim of privilege (Choice A).

Educational objective:
Federal rules of privilege apply to claims arising under federal law. However, the physician-patient privilege is not recognized under federal law.

选项正确率统计：A选项 25%，B选项 36%（正确选项），C选项 25%，D选项 12%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

普通法特免权


律师-客户特免权为获得法律意见或代理而进行的客户与律师之间的交流

客户永久持有该特免权——即使在客户不再被代理或去世后也是如此
工作成果特免权律师或其代表为准备诉讼而制作的材料
配偶特免权婚姻内交流——配偶在婚姻存续期间的交流
夫妻双方均持有特免权——即使在婚姻结束后也是如此

配偶作证豁免——保护配偶免于就婚姻之前或期间发生的事件，在刑事案件中作出不利于其配偶的证言
证人配偶持有该特免权，直至婚姻关系结束
心理治疗师-患者特免权为诊断或治疗精神或情感状况，心理治疗师（或临床社工）与患者之间的交流

患者持有特免权，心理治疗师必须在患者缺席时主张该特免权
宗教特免权神职人员与忏悔者之间的交流

忏悔者持有特免权，神职人员必须在忏悔者缺席时主张该特免权
†联邦法院适用普通法特免权，但在州法规则适用的多元管辖权案件中除外。

当一项请求权根据联邦法产生（例如，联邦民权法），联邦法同时适用于实体性和程序性问题。因此，只有当原告的特免权主张涉及联邦普通法特免权时，法院才应予以承认（选项C和D错误）。并且，由于联邦法下不存在医生-患者特免权，法院应驳回原告的特免权主张（选项A错误）。

教学目标：
联邦特免权规则适用于根据联邦法产生的请求权。然而，联邦法不承认医生-患者特免权。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 501 (federal common law privilege).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：特免权与法律适用

⚖️ 核心规则：FRE 501

本题的核心考点在于《联邦证据规则》第501条 (Federal Rules of Evidence 501)。该规则决定了在联邦法院审理的案件中，究竟是适用联邦普通法还是州法来认定特免权。

规则简述：
  • 一般原则： 适用联邦普通法 (Federal Common Law)。
  • 例外情况： 在民事案件中，如果诉讼请求或抗辩的实质性要素是由州法决定的（通常指多元管辖权案件 Diversity Cases），则特免权适用州法。

🔍 逻辑推演步骤

1 第一步：确定案件性质

题目明确指出原告是根据“联邦民权法” (Federal Civil Rights Law) 提起诉讼。

这意味着本案属于联邦问题管辖权 (Federal Question Jurisdiction)，而非多元管辖权。

👉 结论： 不适用 FRE 501 的例外条款，必须适用联邦法。因此排除选项 C 和 D。

2 第二步：联邦法是否有该特免权？

现在我们确定适用联邦法，接下来要问：联邦普通法是否承认“医生-患者特免权” (Physician-Patient Privilege)？

  • 联邦普通法承认“心理治疗师-患者特免权” (Psychotherapist-Patient Privilege)。
  • 但联邦普通法不承认一般的“医生-患者特免权”（针对身体伤害的治疗）。

👉 结论： 既然联邦法不承认此特免权，法院应驳回原告的主张。

✅ 正确答案：B
适用联邦法，且法院应驳回特免权主张。
💡 MBE 避坑指南

1. 区分“医生”与“心理医生”：
MBE 经常利用这一点混淆视听。联邦法保护心理咨询（Jaffee v. Redmond），但不保护普通外科/内科医生的诊疗记录。

2. 忽略州法干扰项：
题目中提到“A州法典保留了普通法特免权”是一个典型的干扰项 (Red Herring)。只要案件是基于联邦法提起的（联邦问题），州法的证据规则通常就不适用，除非涉及补充管辖权下的州法索赔。

questions.question:
A man was charged with embezzling a large sum of money from a company account and consulted with an attorney. After the attorney agreed to take the case, her legal assistant called the man to discuss a fee arrangement and asked the man to make a large payment to place into escrow, which he did. The attorney then retained a forensic accountant to review financial statements released by the prosecution during discovery. In doing so, the forensic accountant met with the man and privately discussed the statements in the attorney's office.
The prosecution subpoenaed both the legal assistant and the forensic accountant to testify at trial. Each has refused to answer any questions concerning their respective conversations with the man, citing the attorney-client privilege.
To whom does this privilege apply?

choices.a: Neither the legal assistant nor the forensic accountant.
choices.b: The forensic accountant only.
choices.c: The legal assistant only.
choices.d: Both the legal assistant and the forensic accountant.

questions.question:
In a personal injury case, the plaintiff sued a retail store for injuries she sustained from a fall in the store. The plaintiff alleged that the store had negligently allowed its entryway to become slippery from snow tracked in from the sidewalk. Before the lawsuit was filed, when the plaintiff first threatened to sue, the store's manager said, "I know that there was slush on that marble entryway, but I think your four-inch-high heels were the real cause of your fall. So let's agree that we'll pay your medical bills, and you release us from any claims you might have." The plaintiff refused the offer. At trial, the plaintiff seeks to testify to the manager's statement that "there was slush on that marble entryway."
Is the statement about the slush in the entryway admissible?

choices.a: No, because it is a statement made in the course of compromise negotiations.
choices.b: No, because the manager denied that the slippery condition was the cause of the plaintiff's fall.
choices.c: Yes, as a statement by an agent about a matter within the scope of his authority.
choices.d: Yes, because the rule excluding offers of compromise does not protect statements of fact made during compromise negotiations.

在一起人身伤害案件中，原告因在一家零售店内摔倒受伤而起诉该店。原告声称，该店因疏忽致使人行道上的雪被带入，导致其入口处变得湿滑。在诉讼提起前，当原告首次威胁要起诉时，该店的经理说：‘我知道那个大理石入口有积雪融水，但我认为你那四英寸高的高跟鞋才是你摔倒的真正原因。所以我们达成协议，我们支付你的医疗费用，你则免除对我们的任何索赔。’原告拒绝了此要约。在庭审中，原告试图就经理所说的‘那个大理石入口有积雪融水’的陈述作证。

关于入口处有积雪融水的陈述是否可以采纳为证据？
options:
A. No, because it is a statement made in the course of compromise negotiations.
不可以，因为该陈述是在和解谈判过程中作出的。

B. No, because the manager denied that the slippery condition was the cause of the plaintiff's fall.
不可以，因为经理否认了湿滑状况是原告摔倒的原因。

C. Yes, as a statement by an agent about a matter within the scope of his authority.
可以，因为这是代理人在其权限范围内就相关事务所作的陈述。

D. Yes, because the rule excluding offers of compromise does not protect statements of fact made during compromise negotiations.
可以，因为排除和解要约的规则并不保护在和解谈判期间作出的事实陈述。
data.explanation:
Compromise offers & negotiations


(FRE 408)
Applicability
  • Offers made with intent to compromise (ie, avoid or end) claim
  • Conduct/statements made during compromise negotiations about claim
Prohibited useNot admissible to: prove/disprove validity or amount of disputed claim or impeach by prior inconsistent statement or contradiction
ExceptionsConduct/statements admissible for above purposes if: made during negotiations in civil dispute involving government regulatory, investigative, or enforcement agency and offered in subsequent criminal case. Admissible for other purpose - eg:
  • proving witness's bias or prejudice
  • negating contention of undue delay
  • proving effort to obstruct criminal investigation or prosecution
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Public policy encourages the settlement of disputes. As a result, FRE 408 bars the admission of evidence of (1) offers of compromise or (2) conduct or statements made during compromise negotiations when that evidence is offered to: prove or disprove the validity or amount of a disputed claim or impeach by a prior inconsistent statement or contradiction.

Here, the plaintiff seeks to testify to the store manager's statement that there was slush on the store's marble entryway where the plaintiff fell. That statement is being offered to prove the validity of the plaintiff's disputed claim that the store negligently allowed its entryway to become slippery, thereby causing her fall. But since that statement was made in the course of compromise negotiations, it is inadmissible.

(Choice B) The manager's denial that the slippery condition caused the plaintiff's fall has no bearing on the admissibility of his statement made during a compromise negotiation.

(Choice C) Out-of-court statements made by a party-opponent's agent about a matter within the scope of the agent's authority are excluded from the rule against hearsay (ie, are nonhearsay). But since the manger's statement here was made during compromise negotiations, it cannot be used to prove the validity of a disputed claim.

(Choice D) FRE 408 does protect statements of fact made during compromise negotiations.

Educational objective: Compromise offers and negotiations are inadmissible when offered to (1) prove or disprove the validity or amount of a disputed claim or (2) impeach by a prior inconsistent statement or contradiction.

选项正确率统计：A选项 55%（正确选项），B选项 0%，C选项 21%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

和解要约与谈判


（FRE 408）
适用性
  • 为和解（即避免或终止）索赔意图而提出的要约
  • 在关于索赔的和解谈判过程中作出的行为/陈述
禁止用途不可采纳为证据以：证明或反驳争议索赔的有效性或金额 或 以先前不一致的陈述或矛盾进行弹劾
例外情况在以下情况下，行为/陈述可为上述目的被采纳为证据：在涉及政府监管、调查或执法机构的民事争议谈判中作出 且 在随后的刑事案件中提出。可为其他目的采纳为证据 - 例如：
  • 证明证人的偏见或成见
  • 反驳关于不当延迟的主张
  • 证明妨碍刑事调查或起诉的企图
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》（Federal Rule of Evidence）。

公共政策鼓励争议的和解。因此，《联邦证据规则》（FRE）第408条禁止采纳以下证据：(1) 和解要约 或 (2) 在和解谈判过程中作出的行为或陈述，当该证据被用于：证明或反驳一项争议索赔的有效性或金额，或通过先前不一致的陈述或矛盾进行弹劾。

在本案中，原告试图就店经理关于原告摔倒的店内大理石入口有积雪融水的陈述作证。该陈述被用以证明原告有争议的索赔的有效性，即该店因疏忽致使其入口湿滑，从而导致她摔倒。但由于该陈述是在和解谈判过程中作出的，因此不可采纳为证据。

（选项B）经理否认湿滑状况是导致原告摔倒的原因，这与他在和解谈判中所作陈述的可采纳性无关。

（选项C）诉讼对方当事人的代理人在其权限范围内就相关事务所作的庭外陈述，被排除在反对传闻证据规则之外（即，不属于传闻证据）。但由于本案中经理的陈述是在和解谈判中作出的，因此不能用以证明争议索赔的有效性。

（选项D）《联邦证据规则》（FRE）第408条确实保护在和解谈判期间作出的事实陈述。

教学目的：当和解要约和谈判被用于（1）证明或反驳争议索赔的有效性或金额，或（2）通过先前不一致的陈述或矛盾进行弹劾时，是不可采纳为证据的。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 408 (compromise offers and negotiations).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law | 证据法

正确答案：A 不可以，因为该陈述是在和解谈判过程中作出的。
(No, because it is a statement made in the course of compromise negotiations.)
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (FRE 408)

本题考察的是《联邦证据规则》第408条（Federal Rule of Evidence 408），即关于“和解要约与谈判”（Compromise Offers and Negotiations）的排除规则。

FRE 408 规则要点： 为了鼓励争议的解决（Public Policy），以下证据在用来证明责任（Liability）或弹劾（Impeach）时是不可采纳的：
  1. 提供或承诺提供有价值的对价以试图和解；
  2. 在和解谈判过程中作出的行为或陈述（Conduct or statements made during compromise negotiations）。

关键分析步骤：

  • 是否存在争议 (Disputed Claim)？
    规则适用的前提是必须已经存在争议（关于有效性或金额）。题目中提到原告“威胁要起诉”（threatened to sue），这表明争议已经产生。
  • 是否属于和解谈判？
    经理说：“让我们达成协议……你免除对我们的索赔”（Let's agree... you release us...）。这明确是一个试图解决争议的“交换条件”（Quid Pro Quo），属于和解谈判。
  • 事实陈述是否受保护？
    这是本题的核心。在普通法（Common Law）下，谈判中的事实承认通常是可以采纳的。但在 FRE 408 下，为了鼓励各方畅所欲言，谈判过程中的所有事实陈述（Statements of Fact）均被保护，不可采纳。
🚫 常见陷阱与错误选项

陷阱 C (Agency/Hearsay)：
很多考生会误选 C。虽然经理的陈述确实属于“对方当事人代理人的陈述”（Admission by Party-Opponent, FRE 801(d)(2)(D)），通常不被视为传闻证据（Non-hearsay）。
但是：证据法中，相关性与政策排除规则（如 FRE 408）优先于传闻规则。 即使它不是传闻，如果它违反了公共政策排除规则（Privilege/Policy Exclusion），依然不可采纳。

陷阱 D (Fact vs. Offer)：
选项 D 声称规则不保护“事实陈述”。这是错误的。FRE 408 明确扩展了保护范围，涵盖了谈判中的行为和陈述，这与旧的普通法规则不同。MBE 考察的是联邦规则。

💡 MBE 提分技巧
区分 FRE 408 与 FRE 409

这是 MBE 最爱考的细微差别：

  • FRE 409 (支付医疗费要约)： 仅排除“支付医疗费的要约或行为”本身。附带的事实陈述是可以采纳的！
  • FRE 408 (和解谈判)： 如果要约包含“以此换取免责/撤诉”（Release of claims），则属于和解。此时，附带的事实陈述也是不可采纳的！

本题关键点： 经理要求了 "release us from any claims"（免除索赔），所以进入了 FRE 408 的保护范围（全保护），而不是 FRE 409（半保护）。

MBE Evidence Review | © 2025 Exam Prep

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued his neighbor in state court for negligently disposing of engine oil and polluting the groundwater in their neighborhood. During discovery, the plaintiff's attorney inadvertently disclosed a letter sent by the plaintiff to the attorney containing the plaintiff's mental impressions on the case. The attorney took no immediate steps to rectify the error but eventually recovered the letter. Under the law of the state where the disclosure occurred, the attorney's actions did not waive the attorney-client privilege.
The plaintiff later sued a farm located in an adjoining state in federal court for allegedly spraying its crops with a banned pesticide that contaminated the groundwater in the plaintiff's neighborhood. Upon learning of the lawsuit, the neighbor shared a copy of the plaintiff's letter with the farm. The farm now seeks to introduce the plaintiff's letter into evidence at trial. The plaintiff objects to the introduction of the letter, claiming it is privileged.
Should the letter be admitted?

choices.a: No, because a document containing a person's mental impressions is nearly always privileged.
choices.b: No, because the disclosure did not constitute a waiver under state law.
choices.c: Yes, because the disclosure waived the privilege under the federal rules.
choices.d: Yes, provided there is evidence that the farm has a substantial need for the letter.

一名原告在州法院起诉其邻居，因其过失处置发动机油，污染了他们社区的地下水。在证据开示期间，原告的律师无意中披露了一封原告发给律师的信函，其中包含原告对案件的内心想法。律师没有立即采取措施纠正该错误，但最终收回了该信函。根据披露发生地的州法律，律师的行为并未导致律师-客户特免权的放弃。

后来，原告在联邦法院起诉了一家位于邻州的农场，指控其使用被禁用的农药喷洒作物，污染了原告社区的地下水。在得知这起诉讼后，邻居与该农场分享了原告信函的副本。该农场现在试图在审判中将原告的信函作为证据提出。原告反对引入该信函，声称其享有特免权。

该信函应被采纳吗？
options:
A. No, because a document containing a person's mental impressions is nearly always privileged.
不应采纳，因为包含个人内心想法的文件几乎总是享有特免权。

B. No, because the disclosure did not constitute a waiver under state law.
不应采纳，因为根据州法律，该披露行为不构成特免权的放弃。

C. Yes, because the disclosure waived the privilege under the federal rules.
应采纳，因为根据联邦规则，该披露行为放弃了特免权。

D. Yes, provided there is evidence that the farm has a substantial need for the letter.
应采纳，前提是有证据表明该农场对该信函有重大需求。
data.explanation:
The attorney-client privilege protects communications between an attorney and a client that were (1) made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice or representation and (2) intended to be and kept confidential. If such a communication was disclosed in a state court proceeding and is now being offered in a federal proceeding (as seen here), the federal court will review the federal rules and the law of the state where the disclosure occurred. Whichever law offers more protection will determine the effect of the disclosure.†

Under the federal rules, a disclosure of a privileged communication will operate as a waiver unless:
  • the disclosure was inadvertent
  • the privilege holder had taken reasonable steps to prevent disclosure and
  • the privilege holder promptly took reasonable steps to rectify the error (not seen here).


However, the attorney's disclosure here did not waive the attorney-client privilege under the law of the state where the disclosure occurred. Since the state law offers more protection, it will determine the effect of the disclosure in this later federal proceeding (Choice C). Therefore, the letter should not be admitted into evidence.

This procedural rule applies to all federal cases, even those based on diversity jurisdiction . But it does not apply if the state court issued an order concerning the effect of the disclosure. In that case, the state court order would control.

(Choice A) Under the attorney work-product doctrine, opinion work product - ie, material containing an attorney's mental impressions - is privileged and discoverable only in rare instances or compelling circumstances. But this protection does not apply to a letter containing a client's mental impressions.

(Choice D) In civil suits, the production of ordinary work product may be compelled by showing a substantial need and that the materials cannot be obtained without undue hardship. Ordinary work product refers to facts gathered by or for an attorney in anticipation of litigation (eg, witness statements) - not a client's mere opinions .

Educational objective: If a privileged communication was disclosed in state court and is now being offered in federal court, the federal court will review the federal rules and the law of the state where the disclosure occurred. Whichever law offers more protection determines the effect of the disclosure.



选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 64%（正确选项），C选项 19%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

attorney-client privilege（律师-客户特免权）保护律师与客户之间的交流，这些交流须满足以下条件：(1) 为了获取法律意见或代理而做出；以及 (2) 意图保密并保持机密。如果此类交流在州法院诉讼程序中被披露，且现在正在联邦诉讼程序中被提出（如本案所示），联邦法院将审查联邦规则以及披露发生地的州法律。任何提供更多保护的法律将决定披露的效力。†

根据联邦规则，享有特免权的交流的披露将构成放弃，除非：
  • 披露是无意的；
  • 特免权持有人已采取合理措施防止披露；并且
  • 特免权持有人及时采取合理措施纠正错误（本案中未见）。


然而，在本案中，根据披露发生地的州法律，律师的披露并未导致律师-客户特免权的放弃。由于州法律提供了更多保护，它将决定在后来的联邦诉讼程序中披露的效力(选项 C)。因此，该信函不应被采纳为证据。

此程序规则适用于所有联邦案件，即使是基于多元管辖权（diversity jurisdiction）的案件。但如果州法院就披露的效力发布了命令，则此规则不适用。在这种情况下，州法院的命令将具有约束力。

(选项 A) 根据律师工作成果原则（attorney work-product doctrine），意见性工作成果——即包含律师内心想法的材料——享有特免权，并且只有在罕见情况或有说服力的情况下才可被开示。但此保护不适用于包含客户内心想法的信函。

(选项 D) 在民事诉讼中，可以通过证明存在重大需求且不经过度困难无法获得该材料，来强制要求提供普通工作成果。普通工作成果指的是由律师或为律师在预期诉讼时收集的事实（例如，证人陈述）——而非客户的纯粹意见。

教学目标：如果一项享有特免权的交流在州法院被披露，而现在在联邦法院被提出，联邦法院将审查联邦规则以及披露发生地的州法律。任何提供更多保护的法律将决定披露的效力。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 502(c) (limitations on waiver of attorney-client privilege).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Privilege Waiver (FRE 502)

🔑 核心考点：跨法院披露的特免权放弃

当特免权信息在州法院程序中被披露，而现在要在联邦法院程序中使用时，适用《联邦证据规则》第 502(c) 条 (FRE 502(c))。

本题考察的是一个非常具体的规则：“最大保护原则”。

FRE 502(c) 规则详解

联邦法院在判定该披露是否构成“特免权放弃” (Waiver) 时，会比较以下两者的法律：

  1. 州法律（披露发生地）；
  2. 联邦法律。

哪一方的法律认定“未放弃”，
就适用哪一方的法律。

即：哪条法律对特免权保护得更好，就听谁的。

本案逻辑推演

1
州法院阶段：
律师无意披露了信件。虽然律师没有立即补救，但题目明确指出：根据州法律，这不构成放弃。
2
联邦法院阶段：
现在被告（农场）想在联邦法院使用这封信。
3
法律冲突分析：
  • 联邦规则 (FRE 502(b))： 通常要求律师采取“及时合理的补救措施”才不算放弃。本案律师未及时补救，按联邦法可能已放弃。
  • 州法律： 明确规定“未放弃”。
4
结论 (Choice B)：
根据 FRE 502(c)，联邦法院必须适用提供更多保护的法律。既然州法律说没放弃，那就是没放弃。证据不可采纳。
🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A (Work Product):
错误。虽然包含律师内心想法的文件（Opinion Work Product）极难被开示，但这封信是客户写给律师的，属于律师-客户特免权 (Attorney-Client Privilege)，而非律师工作成果。

选项 C (Federal Rules):
错误。这是最强的干扰项。虽然根据联邦规则本身可能构成放弃（因为律师没及时补救），但 FRE 502(c) 强制联邦法院在这种情况下尊重州法律的“不放弃”认定。

选项 D (Substantial Need):
错误。“实质性需求” (Substantial Need) 是克服普通工作成果 (Ordinary Work Product) 保护的例外，不适用于核心的律师-客户特免权交流。

Exam Tip: 看到“State Court Disclosure” -> “Federal Court Case” 的组合，立即想到 FRE 502(c)：谁保护得好听谁的。

questions.question:
A woman sued her friend for injuries she received as a passenger in the friend's car. On direct examination, the woman testified that the friend had been speeding and ran a red light. On cross-examination, the woman was asked whether she was under the influence of drugs at the time of the accident. The woman invoked the privilege against self-incrimination.
How should the court treat the woman's claim of privilege?

choices.a: Deny it, because evidence of the woman's drug intoxication is essential to assessing the accuracy of her observations.
choices.b: Deny it, because the woman waived the privilege by voluntarily testifying.
choices.c: Uphold it, because the privilege applies in both civil and criminal cases.
choices.d: Uphold it, because the woman's credibility cannot be impeached by a crime for which she has not been convicted.

data.questionStem:
Q87132

A woman sued her friend for injuries she received as a passenger in the friend's car. On direct examination, the woman testified that the friend had been speeding and ran a red light. On cross-examination, the woman was asked whether she was under the influence of drugs at the time of the accident. The woman invoked the privilege against self-incrimination.

How should the court treat the woman's claim of privilege?

一名女子因作为其朋友车内的乘客而受伤，故起诉其朋友。在主诘问中，该女子作证称其朋友当时超速并闯了红灯。在反诘问中，该女子被问及在事故发生时是否受药物影响。该女子援引了反对自证其罪的特权。

法院应如何处理该女子的特权主张？
options:
A. Deny it, because evidence of the woman's drug intoxication is essential to assessing the accuracy of her observations.
驳回该主张，因为该女子受药物影响的证据对于评估其观察的准确性至关重要。

B. Deny it, because the woman waived the privilege by voluntarily testifying.
驳回该主张，因为该女子通过自愿作证已经放弃了该特权。

C. Uphold it, because the privilege applies in both civil and criminal cases.
支持该主张，因为该特权在民事和刑事案件中均适用。

D. Uphold it, because the woman's credibility cannot be impeached by a crime for which she has not been convicted.
支持该主张，因为不能以一项该女子未被定罪的罪行来弹劾其可信度。
data.explanation:
The Fifth Amendment privilege against self-incrimination :
  • protects a criminal defendant from being compelled to produce self-incriminating testimonial communications (eg, testify at trial) and
  • allows a witness - in both civil and criminal cases - to refuse to answer questions that the witness reasonably believes might incriminate him/her.

Here, the woman invoked her privilege against self-incrimination after being asked if she was under the influence of drugs at the time of the accident. The woman's belief that her answer might incriminate her - by subjecting her to a future prosecution for drug possession - was reasonable. And since the privilege against self-incrimination applies in both civil and criminal cases, the court should uphold her claim of privilege.

(Choice A) As a general evidentiary principle, a party may impeach (ie, discredit) a witness by challenging the witness's perception and recollection. Evidence of the woman's drug intoxication - which would affect both - is essential to assessing the accuracy of her observations. However, her constitutional right against self-incrimination trumps this principle.

(Choice B) Although a criminal defendant waives the privilege against self-incrimination by testifying as to his/her culpability, a witness does not waive the privilege by voluntarily testifying. However, if the witness voluntarily testifies about a potentially incriminating matter (not seen here), the privilege is waived, and the opposing party may examine the witness on that matter.

(Choice D) A witness's credibility can be impeached by a crime for which he/she has not been convicted if (1) the crime affected the witness's perception or memory (as argued here) or (2) the crime concerns the witness's character for truthfulness. Therefore, this is not a basis to uphold the woman's claim of privilege.

Educational objective: The privilege against self-incrimination (1) protects a criminal defendant from being compelled to produce self-incriminating testimonial communications and (2) allows a witness, in both civil and criminal cases, to refuse to answer questions that the witness reasonably believes might incriminate him/her.



选项正确率统计：A选项 28%，B选项 9%，C选项 58%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

Fifth Amendment的反对自证其罪的特权：
  • 保护刑事被告人免于被迫提供自证其罪的证言性通讯（例如，在审判中作证）并且
  • 允许证人——在民事和刑事案件中——拒绝回答其合理相信可能使其入罪的问题。

在本案中，该女子在被问及事故发生时是否受药物影响后，援引了其反对自证其罪的特权。该女子相信其回答可能使其入罪——即可能因持有毒品而遭受未来起诉——这种信念是合理的。并且，由于反对自证其罪的特权在民事和刑事案件中均适用，法院应支持其特权主张。

(选项 A) 作为一项一般证据原则，一方当事人可以通过挑战证人的感知和记忆来弹劾（即，削弱其可信度）证人。该女子受药物影响的证据——这会影响感知和记忆——对于评估其观察的准确性是至关重要的。然而，她反对自证其罪的宪法权利优先于此原则。

(选项 B) 尽管刑事被告人通过就其罪责作证而放弃了反对自证其罪的特权，但证人并不会因自愿作证而放弃该特权。然而，如果证人就某一可能致其入罪的事项自愿作证（本案未见此情况），则该特权被放弃，并且对方当事人可以就该事项对证人进行诘问。

(选项 D) 在以下情况下，证人的可信度可以因其未被定罪的罪行而受到弹劾：(1) 该罪行影响了证人的感知或记忆（如本案所主张），或 (2) 该罪行关乎证人的诚信品格。因此，这不能作为支持该女子特权主张的依据。

教学目的：反对自证其罪的特权 (1) 保护刑事被告人免于被迫提供自证其罪的证言性通讯，并且 (2) 允许证人在民事和刑事案件中，拒绝回答其合理相信可能使其入罪的问题。

References

U.S. Const. amend. V (privilege against self-incrimination).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence & Constitutional Law
正确答案：C

核心法律规则

反对自证其罪的特权 (Privilege Against Self-Incrimination) 不仅适用于刑事案件，也适用于民事案件。

根据美国宪法第五修正案 (Fifth Amendment)，证人可以在任何诉讼程序（包括民事诉讼）中拒绝回答问题，只要该证人合理相信其回答可能在未来的刑事起诉中被用来指控自己。

案情逻辑分析

⚖️
适用范围：虽然这是一起民事侵权诉讼（车祸赔偿），但如果该女子承认当时“受毒品影响” (under the influence of drugs)，这可能构成持有或使用受控物质的刑事犯罪证据。因此，她有权援引第五修正案。
🚫
特权未被放弃 (No Waiver)： 这是本题最大的陷阱。
  • 刑事被告 (Criminal Defendant)： 一旦选择坐上证人席作证，就视为放弃了针对所有相关交叉询问的特权。
  • 普通证人/民事当事人 (Witness/Civil Party)： 仅仅因为自愿作证并不视为放弃特权。只有当证人主动披露了特定的自证其罪的事实后，才视为对该特定事项放弃特权。
在本案中，她在主诘问 (Direct Examination) 中只谈到了朋友的驾驶行为（超速、闯红灯），并未提及自己的药物使用情况，因此她没有放弃关于药物问题的特权。

为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A 错误 证据相关性 vs. 宪法特权
虽然药物影响确实会削弱证人的感知能力，是极佳的弹劾证据 (Impeachment Evidence)，但在法律位阶上，宪法赋予的反对自证其罪特权优先于证据获取的需求。法院不能因为某证据“至关重要”就强迫证人放弃宪法权利。
选项 B 错误 关于“放弃” (Waiver) 的误解
如前所述，民事原告/证人不会仅仅因为出庭作证就自动放弃第五修正案特权。她必须具体谈论了药物话题才算放弃。
选项 D 错误 弹劾规则的误用
这个选项混淆了概念。虽然通常不能用“未定罪的逮捕记录”来弹劾证人，但如果某种行为（如吸毒）直接影响了证人当时的感知或记忆能力 (Sensory Capacity)，对方是可以询问的。法院支持特权的理由是宪法权利，而不是因为该问题在证据法上不相关。

🎓 MBE 拿分技巧

看到 "Civil Case" + "Self-Incrimination" 的组合时，请记住：

  1. 第五修正案特权在民事庭审中依然有效。
  2. 区分刑事被告和普通证人：
    • 刑事被告作证 = 全面放弃特权。
    • 普通证人作证 = 仅针对自愿披露的特定罪行放弃特权。
  3. 宪法特权 > 证据的可采性/相关性。

questions.question:
A plaintiff sued a defendant, the owner of a department store, for injuries sustained when he slipped and fell in the defendant's store. The cause of the fall is in dispute. In preparation for trial, the plaintiff's attorney interviewed the only eyewitness to the incident and took notes as the eyewitness narrated the events leading up to the fall. The eyewitness had not spoken to anyone else about the incident and is now deceased. The defendant filed a motion to compel the production of the notes during discovery. The plaintiff's attorney objects on the ground of privilege.
Will production of the notes be required?

choices.a: No, because the notes are protected by the attorney-client privilege.
choices.b: No, because the notes are protected by the attorney work-product doctrine.
choices.c: Yes, because the eyewitness's account is unavailable by other means.
choices.d: Yes, provided there is good reason to believe that the notes contain inconsistent statements.

一名原告因在被告的百货商店滑倒受伤而起诉该商店的所有人，即被告。跌倒的原因存在争议。为准备庭审，原告的律师约谈了事件的唯一目击证人，并在该目击证人叙述导致跌倒的事件经过时做了笔记。该目击证人没有和任何其他人谈论过此事，且现已去世。在证据开示程序中，被告提交了一项动议，要求强制出示这些笔记。原告的律师以享有特免权为由提出异议。

法院会要求出示这些笔记吗？
options:
A. No, because the notes are protected by the attorney-client privilege.
不会，因为这些笔记受到律师-当事人特免权的保护。

B. No, because the notes are protected by the attorney work-product doctrine.
不会，因为这些笔记受到律师工作成果原则的保护。

C. Yes, because the eyewitness's account is unavailable by other means.
会，因为目击证人的陈述无法通过其他方式获得。

D. Yes, provided there is good reason to believe that the notes contain inconsistent statements.
会，前提是有充分理由相信笔记中包含相互矛盾的陈述。
data.explanation:
Attorney work-product doctrine


(protects materials prepared by or for attorney in anticipation of litigation)
DescriptionException
Opinion work product Attorney's opinions, legal theories & conclusions, mental impressionsDiscoverable in rare instances of compelling need - eg, to show attorney's fraud
Ordinary work product Facts gathered by attorney - eg, witness statements, notes & other materialsDiscoverable in civil suit if requesting party shows substantial need & undue hardship
Under the attorney work-product doctrine, materials (eg, documents and tangible things) prepared by or for an attorney in anticipation of litigation are privileged and are generally not subject to discovery. This doctrine encompasses two types of work product:
  • Opinion work product - an attorney's opinions, legal theories and conclusions, and mental impressions (not seen here)
  • Ordinary work product - facts gathered by an attorney as well as witness statements, notes, and other items prepared in anticipation of litigation (as seen with the notes here)
Opinion work product is almost always protected from discovery. However, in civil suits,† a party may compel the production of ordinary work product if the party demonstrates that it (1) has a substantial need for the materials to prepare its case and (2) cannot obtain the materials by other means without undue hardship.

Here, there is no other eyewitness to the fall, so the defendant has a substantial need for the information in the notes. And since the eyewitness is now deceased, the defendant cannot obtain the information by other means. Therefore, the court will likely require the production of the notes (Choice B).

†In criminal cases, the prosecution is constitutionally required to disclose exculpatory evidence contained within work-product materials - but not the work product itself. And the defense is only required to disclose work product contained in certain scientific or medical reports.

(Choice A) The attorney-client privilege protects communications between an attorney and a client that were (1) made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice and/or representation and (2) intended to be confidential. Therefore, this privilege does not cover the attorney's notes from an eyewitness interview.

(Choice D) Good reason to believe that the notes contain inconsistent statements helps show that the notes are relevant to the defendant's case and therefore within the scope of discovery. But relevancy alone is not a basis to overcome a valid claim of privilege.

Educational objective: Production of ordinary work product - eg, witness statements and notes gathered in anticipation of litigation - can be compelled only if the requesting party demonstrates that it (1) has a substantial need for the materials and (2) cannot obtain the materials by other means without undue hardship.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 18%，C选项 78%（正确选项），D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

律师工作成果原则


（保护律师或其代表为预期诉讼而准备的材料）
描述例外情况
意见性工作成果 律师的意见、法律理论与结论、思想印象在有迫切需求的罕见情况下可以被开示——例如，为证明律师的欺诈行为
普通工作成果 律师收集的事实——例如，证人陈述、笔记及其他材料在民事诉讼中，如果请求方能证明有实质性需求且存在过度困难，则可以被开示
根据律师工作成果原则，由律师或其代表为预期诉讼而准备的材料（例如，文件和有形物品）享有特免权，并且通常不属于证据开示的范围。该原则包含两种类型的工作成果：
  • 意见性工作成果——律师的意见、法律理论与结论，以及思想印象（本案未涉及）
  • 普通工作成果——律师收集的事实以及为预期诉讼而准备的证人陈述、笔记和其他项目（如本案中的笔记）
意见性工作成果几乎总是受到保护，免于证据开示。然而，在民事诉讼中，† 如果一方当事人能证明其（1）为准备案件对这些材料有实质性需求，并且（2）不造成过度困难便无法通过其他方式获得这些材料，则该方可以强制要求出示普通工作成果。

在本案中，没有其他目击证人看到跌倒过程，因此被告对笔记中的信息有实质性需求。并且由于目击证人现已去世，被告无法通过其他方式获得这些信息。因此，法院很可能会要求出示这些笔记（选项B）。

†在刑事案件中，检方有宪法义务披露包含在工作成果材料中的可免除罪责的证据——但不是工作成果材料本身。而辩方仅被要求披露包含在某些科学或医学报告中的工作成果。

（选项A） 律师-当事人特免权保护律师与当事人之间的沟通，前提是这些沟通（1）是为了获得法律咨询和/或代理而进行的，并且（2）意图是保密的。因此，该特免权不涵盖律师约谈目击证人的笔记。

（选项D） 有充分理由相信笔记中包含相互矛盾的陈述，这有助于证明这些笔记与被告的案件相关，因此属于证据开示的范围。但是，仅凭相关性本身，并不足以推翻一项有效的特免权主张。

教学目标： 普通工作成果——例如，为预期诉讼而收集的证人陈述和笔记——只有在请求方能证明其（1）对这些材料有实质性需求，并且（2）不造成过度困难便无法通过其他方式获得这些材料时，才可被强制要求提供。

References

  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(b)(3) (attorney work product).
  • Hickman v. Taylor, 329 U.S. 495, 509 (1947) (recognizing the work-product privilege).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure / Evidence

正确答案：C

本题的核心考点在于律师工作成果原则 (Attorney Work-Product Doctrine) 的例外情况。虽然律师的笔记通常受到保护，但在特定条件下必须披露。

1. 法律规则解析
根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第26(b)(3)条 (Fed. R. Civ. P. 26(b)(3))，律师为预期诉讼而准备的材料享有特免权。但是，这种保护并非绝对。

我们需要区分两种类型的工作成果：

类型 定义与保护程度
意见性工作成果
(Opinion Work Product)		 包含律师的法律理论、策略、印象或意见。
几乎绝对受保护，极难被强制披露。
普通工作成果
(Ordinary Work Product)		 律师收集的事实性材料（如本题中的证人访谈笔记）。
有条件受保护 (Qualified Immunity)。
2. 强制披露的“两步测试”

对于普通工作成果（如事实笔记），如果请求方能证明以下两点，法院可强制要求出示：

  1. 实质性需求 (Substantial Need)： 请求方在准备案件时非常需要这些材料。
  2. 过度困难 (Undue Hardship)： 请求方无法通过其他手段获得相当的资料，或者获得这些资料需要付出极大的代价。
3. 案情应用

在本案中：

  • 事实： 原告律师采访了唯一的目击证人。
  • 关键点： 该证人现已去世 (Deceased)。
  • 结论： 被告无法通过约谈证人来获取信息（因为人已经死了），且没有其他目击者。这构成了典型的“过度困难”和“实质性需求”。

因此，尽管这些笔记是律师的工作成果，但由于证人死亡且不可替代，特免权被打破，笔记必须被出示。

4. 为什么其他选项是错的？

❌ 选项 A (Attorney-Client Privilege):
律师-当事人特免权仅保护律师与客户之间的沟通。本案中的目击证人是第三方，不是客户，因此不适用此特免权。

❌ 选项 B (Work-Product Doctrine):
虽然笔记确实属于工作成果，但如上所述，本案满足了“实质性需求”和“过度困难”的例外条件，因此保护失效。

❌ 选项 D (Inconsistent Statements):
仅凭“有理由相信存在矛盾陈述”通常不足以克服工作成果特免权。必须证明无法通过其他途径获取该信息（即Undue Hardship）。

💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
在 MBE 考试中，看到“律师笔记 (Attorney's notes)” + “证人死亡/失踪 (Witness deceased/unavailable)” 的组合时，几乎总是指向 Work-Product Doctrine 的例外。

注意区分：如果是律师的纯法律分析（Opinion），即使证人死了通常也不用交；如果是事实记录（Ordinary），证人死了通常必须交。

questions.question:
A woman is suing a pilot for injuries suffered in the crash of a small airplane, alleging that the pilot had owned the plane and negligently failed to have it properly maintained. The pilot has asserted in defense that he never owned the plane or had any responsibility to maintain it. At trial, the woman calls a witness to testify that he had sold to the pilot a liability insurance policy on the plane.
Is the witness's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because of the rule against proof of insurance where insurance is not itself at issue.
choices.b: No, because the policy itself is required under the original document rule.
choices.c: Yes, as some evidence of the pilot's ownership of or responsibility for the airplane.
choices.d: Yes, to show that the pilot had little motivation to invest money in maintenance of the airplane.

The pilot has asserted in defense that he never owned the plane or had any responsibility to maintain it. At trial, the woman calls a witness to testify that he had sold to the pilot a liability insurance policy on the plane.

Is the witness's testimony admissible?

一名女性因在一架小型飞机坠毁事故中受伤而起诉一名飞行员，指控该飞行员拥有该飞机，并因过失未能对其进行适当维护。该飞行员在辩护中声称，他从未拥有该飞机，也没有任何责任维护它。在庭审中，该女性传唤一名证人作证，称其曾向该飞行员出售过该飞机的责任保险单。

该证人的证言是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because of the rule against proof of insurance where insurance is not itself at issue.
否，因为根据禁止在保险本身不构成争议点时提供保险证明的规则。

B. No, because the policy itself is required under the original document rule.
否，因为根据最佳证据规则，必须出示保单本身。

C. Yes, as some evidence of the pilot's ownership of or responsibility for the airplane.
是，作为证明飞行员拥有该飞机或对其负有责任的部分证据。

D. Yes, to show that the pilot had little motivation to invest money in maintenance of the airplane.
是，用以表明该飞行员几乎没有动机投入资金维护该飞机。
data.explanation:
Liability insurance


(FRE 411) Evidence that person was or was not insured against liability is inadmissible to prove person acted negligently or wrongfully
Evidence of liability insurance is admissible for nonsubstantive purpose - eg:
  • to impeach witness with evidence of self-interest, bias, or prejudice
  • to prove agency, ownership, or control
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence

Under Federal Rule of Evidence 411, evidence of liability insurance or the lack thereof is inadmissible to prove negligence or wrongdoing. For example, such evidence is inadmissible to support a negligence claim by arguing that the defendant had little motivation to maintain an insured vehicle (Choice D). But such evidence is admissible for other purposes, such as proving ownership or control of the insured item (Choice A).

Therefore, the witness's testimony that he sold the pilot a liability insurance policy on the airplane is admissible as evidence of the pilot's ownership of or responsibility for that airplane.

(Choice B) The best evidence rule generally requires that an original writing, recording, or photograph be produced to prove its contents. But the rule does not apply here because the woman only seeks to show that the pilot had an insurance policy on the plane - not to prove the contents of that policy.

Educational objective: Evidence of liability insurance or the lack thereof is inadmissible to prove negligence or wrongdoing. But a court may admit such evidence for another purpose, such as to prove ownership or control of the insured item.

选项正确率统计：A选项 4%，B选项 0%，C选项 93%（正确选项），D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

责任保险


(FRE 411) 某人是否投保责任险的证据，用以证明该人行为存在过失或不法时，是不可采纳的
责任保险的证据，用于非实体性目的时是可采纳的——例如：
  • 以显示自身利益、偏见或成见的证据来弹劾证人
  • 证明代理、所有权或控制权
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence (联邦证据规则)

根据《联邦证据规则》第411条 (Federal Rule of Evidence 411)，关于责任保险的有无的证据，在用于证明过失或不法行为时是不可采纳的。例如，此类证据不可用于支持过失主张，如辩称被告几乎没有动机去维护已投保的车辆（选项D）。但此类证据可用于其他目的，例如证明对投保物品的所有权或控制权（选项A）。

因此，证人关于他曾向飞行员出售该飞机责任保险单的证言，可作为证明飞行员对该飞机拥有所有权或负有责任的证据而被采纳。

（选项B） 最佳证据规则通常要求，为证明书面文件、录音或照片的内容，必须出示其原件。但该规则在此处不适用，因为该女性仅试图证明飞行员为该飞机购买了保险单——而非证明该保单的具体内容。

教学目的： 关于责任保险的有无的证据，不可用于证明过失或不法行为。但法院可以为其他目的采纳此类证据，例如证明对投保物品的所有权或控制权。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 411 (liability insurance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / 证据法
核心规则：FRE 411

关于责任保险 (Liability Insurance) 的证据：

  • ❌ 不可采纳 (Inadmissible)：用于证明当事人的过失 (Negligence) 或不当行为。
  • ✅ 可采纳 (Admissible)：用于证明其他目的，例如：
    • 所有权 (Ownership)
    • 控制权 (Control)
    • 偏见 (Bias)
    *前提是这些问题在案件中存在争议 (Disputed)。
题目逻辑分析

本题的关键在于被告（飞行员）的辩护策略。

飞行员明确声称：“他从未拥有该飞机，也没有任何责任维护它。”

这就创造了一个关于所有权和控制权的争议 (Dispute as to ownership or control)。

✔ 正确答案 C

理由：原告引入保险证据并非为了证明飞行员“因为买了保险所以行为鲁莽”（这是被禁止的），而是为了反驳飞行员关于“我不拥有这架飞机”的说法。

逻辑是：人们通常不会为自己不拥有或不负责的东西购买责任险。因此，这是证明所有权 (Ownership) 的相关证据。

为什么其他选项是错的？
陷阱 1：最佳证据规则 (Best Evidence Rule) - 选项 B

这是 MBE 常见的干扰项。最佳证据规则仅在试图证明“文件的内容” (Contents of a writing) 时才适用。

在此案中，原告只是想证明“购买了保险”这一事实 (Fact) 或交易行为，而不是证明保单里的具体条款。因此，不需要出示保单原件。

陷阱 2：证明过失/动机 - 选项 D

选项 D 建议用保险证据来证明飞行员“没有动机去维护飞机”，这本质上是在暗示因为有保险所以他疏忽大意。这正是 FRE 411 明确禁止的用途。

🎓 考试通关秘籍：

遇到涉及“保险证据”的题目，请遵循以下两步：
  1. 目的检查：如果是为了证明被告有过失（Negligence），直接排除（不可采纳）。
  2. 争议检查：如果是为了证明所有权、控制权或证人偏见，必须检查被告是否否认了这些事实。只有在存在争议（Disputed）时，该证据才可采纳。

questions.question:
A woman sued a homeowner, alleging that, while the woman was on her morning walk, a limb fell from a tree on the homeowner's property and hit her. The woman further alleged that the tree had started to rot, causing the limb to fall, and that the homeowner was negligent in failing to maintain the tree. The homeowner denied responsibility, claiming that the tree sits on city property. Over a year later, the case went to trial. The woman failed to produce a plat map that would have accurately indicated the boundaries of the homeowner's property. Instead, while testifying, the woman offered a video that had been taken the week prior and showed the homeowner cutting down the tree, which had entirely rotted by that time.
Should the court admit the video?

choices.a: No, because it constitutes evidence of a subsequent remedial measure.
choices.b: No, because it is not the best evidence of the tree's location.
choices.c: Yes, because it helps establish ownership of the tree.
choices.d: Yes, provided that the woman can show that she was the maker of the video.

A woman sued a homeowner, alleging that, while the woman was on her morning walk, a limb fell from a tree on the homeowner's property and hit her. The woman further alleged that the tree had started to rot, causing the limb to fall, and that the homeowner was negligent in failing to maintain the tree. The homeowner denied responsibility, claiming that the tree sits on city property. Over a year later, the case went to trial. The woman failed to produce a plat map that would have accurately indicated the boundaries of the homeowner's property. Instead, while testifying, the woman offered a video that had been taken the week prior and showed the homeowner cutting down the tree, which had entirely rotted by that time.

Should the court admit the video?

一名女子起诉了一位房主，指控称，当她在晨间散步时，房主房产上的一棵树的树枝掉落并砸中了她。该女子进一步指控，该树已经开始腐烂，导致树枝掉落，并且房主因未能维护该树而存在过失。房主否认责任，声称该树位于市政财产上。一年多后，该案进入庭审。该女子未能出示能够准确标示房主房产边界的地籍图。相反，在作证时，该女子出示了一段于前一周拍摄的视频，视频显示房主正在砍伐当时已经完全腐烂的树。

法院是否应当采纳该视频？
options:
A. No, because it constitutes evidence of a subsequent remedial measure.
不应当，因为它构成了事后补救措施的证据。

B. No, because it is not the best evidence of the tree's location.
不应当，因为它不是证明树木位置的最佳证据。

C. Yes, because it helps establish ownership of the tree.
应当，因为它有助于确定树木的所有权。

D. Yes, provided that the woman can show that she was the maker of the video.
应当，前提是该女子能证明她是该视频的制作者。
data.explanation:
Evidence of subsequent remedial measures (FRE 407)


Inadmissible
Such measures cannot be used to:
  • prove negligence or other culpable conduct
  • prove defect in product or product design
  • prove need for product warning or instruction
Admissible
Such measures can be used to:
  • prove feasibility of precautionary measures
  • impeach witness
  • prove ownership or control
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence. A subsequent remedial measure is a precaution taken after an injury has occurred that - if taken earlier - might have prevented the injury. Because social policy encourages remedial measures to protect the public, evidence of such measures is inadmissible to prove negligence or other culpable conduct. But a court may allow evidence of subsequent remedial measures for other limited purposes such as:
  • resolving a dispute about the feasibility of precautionary measures
  • impeaching a witness
  • or proving ownership or control.


Here, the woman offered video evidence of the homeowner's subsequent remedial measure of cutting down the tree, which had entirely rotted by the time of trial. That evidence is not admissible to prove the homeowner's negligence in failing to maintain the tree. However, it is admissible to prove ownership of the tree (Choice A). And the video is relevant to ownership since it is unlikely that the homeowner would have cut down the tree if the homeowner truly believed that it sat on city property.

(Choice B) The best evidence rule applies when a witness relies on a recording, writing, or photograph's contents while testifying or when the contents of the item are at issue (not seen here). Additionally, this rule does not require that a party introduce the most definitive evidence of a fact that the party seeks to prove.

(Choice D) A video is authenticated by having a witness with personal knowledge of the thing depicted (here, the tree) testify that the video fairly and accurately depicts that thing. Therefore, the video need not be authenticated by the person who made it.

Educational objective: Evidence of subsequent remedial measures is inadmissible to prove negligence or other culpable conduct. But such evidence is admissible to (1) resolve a dispute about the feasibility of precautionary measures, (2) impeach a witness, or (3) prove ownership or control.

选项正确率统计：A选项 24%，B选项 4%，C选项 70%（正确选项），D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

事后补救措施的证据 (FRE 407)


不可采纳
此类措施不可用于：
  • 证明过失或其他可归责行为
  • 证明产品或产品设计存在缺陷
  • 证明需要产品警告或说明
可采纳
此类措施可用于：
  • 证明预防措施的可行性
  • 弹劾证人
  • 证明所有权或控制权
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。事后补救措施是指在损害发生后采取的、若能提早采取本可防止该损害发生的预防措施。由于社会政策鼓励采取补救措施以保护公众，此类措施的证据不可被采纳用于证明过失或其他可归责行为。但是，法院可允许为此类其他有限目的采纳事后补救措施的证据，例如：
  • 解决关于预防措施可行性的争议
  • 弹劾证人
  • 或证明所有权或控制权。


在本案中，该女子出示了房主采取事后补救措施砍伐树木的视频证据，而在庭审时该树已完全腐烂。该证据不可被采纳用以证明房主在维护树木方面的过失。然而，它可以被采纳用以证明树木的所有权（选项 A）。并且，该视频与所有权相关，因为如果房主真的相信该树位于市政财产上，他就不太可能砍掉它。

（选项 B）最佳证据规则适用于证人在作证时依赖于录音、书面文件或照片的内容，或者当物品内容本身是争议焦点时（本案中未出现此情况）。此外，该规则不要求一方当事人必须出示其试图证明的事实的最确凿的证据。

（选项 D）视频的认证方式是，由一名对所描绘事物（此处为树木）有亲身认知的证人作证，证明该视频公正、准确地描绘了该事物。因此，该视频无需由其制作者进行认证。

教学目标：事后补救措施的证据不可被采纳用以证明过失或其他可归责行为。但此类证据可被采纳用于（1）解决关于预防措施可行性的争议，（2）弹劾证人，或（3）证明所有权或控制权。

References

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法) - FRE 407
核心规则：事后补救措施 (Subsequent Remedial Measures) 根据《联邦证据规则》第407条 (FRE 407)：

一般原则： 在伤害发生后采取的、若提早采取本可防止伤害的措施，不可用来证明过失 (Negligence) 或应受谴责的行为。

例外情况： 如果存在争议 (Disputed)，此类证据可以用来证明：
  • 所有权 (Ownership)
  • 控制权 (Control)
  • 预防措施的可行性 (Feasibility of precautionary measures)
案情关键点分析

本题的解题关键在于捕捉题目中的“争议点”：

  1. 被告的抗辩： 房主否认责任，声称树位于市政财产 (City Property) 上。这意味着房主否认了对树的所有权 (Ownership)。
  2. 原告的证据： 视频显示房主事后砍掉了这棵树。
  3. 逻辑推理： 通常只有树的主人才有权砍树。如果树真的属于市政府，房主去砍树是不合常理的。因此，砍树的行为（事后补救措施）直接反驳了房主关于“树不归我管”的辩解。
为何选 C？
✅ 选项 C (正确)
"Yes, because it helps establish ownership of the tree."
虽然砍树是事后补救措施，不能用来证明房主当初维护不当（过失），但因为房主明确否认了所有权（声称树在市政土地上），该证据符合 FRE 407 的例外情形。法院应当采纳该视频以证明树木归房主所有。
❌ 选项 A (错误)
虽然这是事后补救措施，但选项 A 忽略了 FRE 407 的例外条款。当所有权存在争议时，该规则不再禁止此类证据的引入。
❌ 选项 B (错误)
最佳证据规则 (Best Evidence Rule) 仅适用于证明“文件、录音或照片的内容”本身。本案中，原告是用视频证明“房主砍树”这一行为/事实，而非证明某份地籍图的内容。此外，该规则并不要求当事人必须提供最完美的证据。
❌ 选项 D (错误)
认证 (Authentication) 不需要视频的拍摄者亲自出庭。只要有任何具有亲身感知知识 (Personal Knowledge) 的证人（如原告本人）作证说“该视频真实准确地反映了当时的场景”，即可完成认证。
💡 MBE 抢分技巧 在处理 FRE 407 (事后补救措施) 的题目时，请遵循以下步骤：
  1. 确认这是事后采取的安全措施（修路、改设计、解雇员工等）。
  2. 默认该证据不可用来证明过失。
  3. 关键步骤： 检查被告是否在答辩中使用了 "I don't own it" (否认所有权) 或 "It was impossible to make it safer" (否认可行性) 这样的措辞。
  4. 如果被告否认 (Disputed) 了上述事项，那么该证据就是可采纳 (Admissible) 的。

Is the best friend's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because evidence of the victim's sexual behavior is inadmissible.
choices.b: No, because the testimony is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.c: Yes, because the testimony goes to the issue of consent.
choices.d: Yes, provided that the testimony's probative value substantially outweighs any harm to the victim.

data.questionStem:
Q87159

A defendant was charged with sexual assault. At trial, the defendant has called the victim's best friend to testify that the victim stated on the night of the alleged assault that she intended to sleep with the defendant.

Is the best friend's testimony admissible?

一名被告被指控性侵犯。在审判中，被告传唤了受害者的挚友作证，证明受害者在被指控的侵犯发生的当晚曾表示，她打算与被告发生性关系。

该挚友的证词是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because evidence of the victim's sexual behavior is inadmissible.
否，因为有关受害者性行为的证据不予采纳。

B. No, because the testimony is hearsay not within any exception.
否，因为该证词是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

C. Yes, because the testimony goes to the issue of consent.
是，因为该证词涉及同意问题。

D. Yes, provided that the testimony's probative value substantially outweighs any harm to the victim.
是，前提是该证词的证明价值实质上超过对受害者的任何伤害。
data.explanation:
This testimony must overcome two potential obstacles to be admissible: the rule against hearsay and the Rape Shield Law (FRE 412).

First, the statement—an out-of-court statement offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted (that the victim had this intent)—is hearsay. However, it falls squarely within the FRE 803(3) exception for a then-existing state of mind. A statement of the declarant's then-existing intent or plan is admissible to prove the declarant's subsequent conduct in conformity with that intent. Here, the victim's statement of intent to sleep with the defendant is offered to show she likely acted on that intent, which is relevant to consent.

Second, FRE 412 (the Rape Shield Law) generally bars evidence of a victim's past sexual behavior or predisposition. A statement of future intent is arguably not evidence of past behavior. However, even if a court were to construe it as evidence of 'predisposition' or otherwise within the scope of FRE 412, the rule provides a crucial exception in criminal cases for evidence of a victim's sexual conduct with the accused when offered to prove consent.

(Choice C) This is the correct answer. It identifies the ultimate legal purpose for which the evidence is admissible. The testimony is allowed past the hearsay and Rape Shield hurdles precisely because it is highly relevant to the critical issue of consent.

(Choice A) This is incorrect because it misapplies the Rape Shield Law (FRE 412). First, a statement of future intent is not an 'instance of sexual behavior' in the past, so the general prohibition may not even apply. Second, even if it did, FRE 412 contains a specific exception for evidence of prior sexual conduct between the victim and the accused when offered by the defendant to prove consent. Since the statement is directly relevant to consent, it falls outside the rule's general prohibition.

(Choice B) This is incorrect. While the statement is hearsay, it is admissible under the FRE 803(3) state of mind exception.

(Choice D) This is incorrect. This balancing test—where probative value must substantially outweigh harm—is the standard for admitting this type of evidence in civil cases under FRE 412(b)(2). It is not the test for the specific criminal case exceptions, such as proving consent.

Educational objective: A victim's statement of intent to engage in sexual conduct with the defendant is admissible to prove consent. It overcomes the hearsay rule via the FRE 803(3) state of mind exception and is not barred by the Rape Shield Law (FRE 412).

FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.



选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 12%，C选项 67%（正确选项），D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

该证词必须克服两个潜在的可采性障碍：传闻证据规则和“强奸盾牌法”（FRE 412）。

首先，该陈述——在庭外作出，为证明其内容（即受害者有此意图）的真实性而提出——是传闻证据。然而，它完全符合FRE 803(3)关于“当时存在的精神状态”的例外。陈述人当时存在的意图或计划的陈述，可以被采纳以证明陈述人随后的行为与该意图相符。在本案中，受害者打算与被告发生性关系的意图陈述，被用以证明她很可能按照该意图行事，这与是否同意相关。

其次，FRE 412（强奸盾牌法）通常禁止采纳关于受害者过去性行为或性倾向的证据。一个关于未来意图的陈述，可以说并非关于过去行为的证据。然而，即使法院将其解释为关于“性倾向”的证据或以其他方式将其纳入FRE 412的范围，该规则在刑事案件中也提供了一个关键例外，即当为证明同意而提出时，允许采纳关于受害者与被告性行为的证据。

(选项C) 这是正确答案。它指出了该证据可被采纳的最终法律目的。该证词之所以能够越过传闻证据和“强奸盾牌法”的障碍，正是因为它与“同意”这一关键问题高度相关。

(选项A) 这是不正确的，因为它错误地应用了“强奸盾牌法”（FRE 412）。首先，一个关于未来意图的陈述并非过去“性行为的实例”，因此一般性的禁令可能根本不适用。其次，即使它适用，FRE 412也包含一个特定的例外，即允许被告为证明同意而提出关于受害者与被告之间先前性行为的证据。由于该陈述与同意直接相关，它不属于该规则的一般禁止范围。

(选项B) 这是不正确的。尽管该陈述是传闻证据，但它可以根据FRE 803(3)精神状态例外而被采纳。

(选项D) 这是不正确的。这种“证明价值必须实质上超过伤害”的权衡测试，是根据FRE 412(b)(2)在民事案件中采纳此类证据的标准，而非适用于本案中证明同意等特定刑事案件例外的测试标准。

教学目标：受害者意图与被告发生性行为的陈述，可以被采纳以证明同意。它通过FRE 803(3)精神状态例外克服了传闻证据规则，且不受“强奸盾牌法”（FRE 412）的禁止。

FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 412 (victim's other sexual behavior).

Fed. R. Evid. 803(3) (then-existing state of mind).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence Law | 证据法

核心考点

本题考察两个证据法规则的交叉点：

FRE 803(3) Hearsay Exception
FRE 412 Rape Shield Law
⚖️ 法律推理步骤
第一步：传闻证据 (Hearsay) 障碍

受害者在庭外说“我打算与被告发生性关系”，这是为了证明她确实有此意图并可能付诸行动。这属于传闻证据。

FRE 803(3) State of Mind Exception:
陈述人关于其当时存在的精神状态（如动机、意图、计划）的陈述，属于传闻例外，可被采纳。

根据 Hillmon 原则，意图的陈述可以用来证明陈述人随后实施了该意图所指的行为。

第二步：强奸盾牌法 (Rape Shield Law) 障碍

FRE 412 通常禁止采纳受害者的性行为证据。但是，在刑事案件中有重要例外。

FRE 412(b)(1)(B) Exception:
如果是关于受害者与被告(Accused)之间具体的性行为实例，且由被告提出以证明同意(Consent)，则可采纳。
✅ 正确答案：C
"Yes, because the testimony goes to the issue of consent."

解析：该证词通过了传闻规则（作为意图的陈述）和强奸盾牌法（作为证明同意的例外）。因此，它是因为与“同意”这一抗辩理由直接相关而被允许的。

🚫 避坑指南 (为何其他选项错误)
选项 A (Inadmissible due to sexual behavior):
错误。忽略了 FRE 412 在刑事案件中关于“与被告的过往行为以证明同意”的例外。
选项 B (Hearsay):
错误。虽然是传闻，但符合 FRE 803(3) "Then-existing state of mind" 例外。
选项 D (Probative value > Harm):
高频陷阱！
这种“反向 403 平衡测试”（证明价值必须实质上超过伤害）仅适用于民事案件 (Civil Cases) (FRE 412(b)(2))。在刑事案件中，只要符合特定例外（如证明同意），通常不需要通过这个严苛的平衡测试。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧

当题目涉及性犯罪受害者的言行时：

  1. 首先检查是否属于 Hearsay 及其例外（通常是 State of Mind）。
  2. 然后检查 FRE 412。记住刑事案件的三大例外：
    • 证明精液/伤害来源 (Source of semen/injury)
    • 与被告的过往行为证明同意 (Consent with accused)
    • 宪法权利要求 (Constitutional rights)
  3. 警惕区分民事与刑事的采纳标准。

On cross-examination, should the court allow the plaintiff to elicit from the witness the fact that he is an adjuster for the defendant's insurance company?

choices.a: No, because testimony about liability insurance is barred by the rules of evidence.
choices.b: No, because the reference to insurance raises a collateral issue.
choices.c: Yes, for both substantive and impeachment purposes.
choices.d: Yes, for impeachment purposes only.

一名原告起诉一名被告，声称其在人行横道上行走时，因被告闯红灯驾车撞到她而严重受伤。在被告方的庭审程序中，一名证人作证称，原告曾告诉他，她只是被被告的车“轻微碰到”。

在交叉询问中，法院是否应允许原告从该证人处引出其是被告保险公司的理赔员这一事实？
options:
A. No, because testimony about liability insurance is barred by the rules of evidence.
不应允许，因为根据证据规则，关于责任保险的证言是被禁止的。

B. No, because the reference to insurance raises a collateral issue.
不应允许，因为提及保险会引发一个附带问题（collateral issue）。

C. Yes, for both substantive and impeachment purposes.
应允许，既可用于实体目的，也可用于弹劾目的。

D. Yes, for impeachment purposes only.
应允许，但仅能用于弹劾目的。
data.explanation:
Liability insurance


(FRE 411) Evidence that person was or was not insured against liability is inadmissible to prove person acted negligently or wrongfully. Evidence of liability insurance is admissible for nonsubstantive purpose - eg:
  • to impeach witness with evidence of self-interest, bias, or prejudice
  • to prove agency, ownership, or control
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence

Under Federal Rule of Evidence 411, evidence that a person was (or was not) covered by liability insurance is not admissible as substantive proof of negligence or wrongdoing. This helps ensure that the jury will not infer fault based on the existence or lack of coverage or base its verdict on the defendant's or insurer's ability to pay. However, this evidence is admissible for nonsubstantive purposes - eg, to impeach a witness.

Here, testimony that the witness is an adjuster for the defendant's insurance company shows that the defendant had liability insurance. Therefore, it cannot be admitted as substantive proof of the defendant's negligence (Choice C). But it can be admitted for impeachment purposes - eg, to show that the witness, as an employee of the defendant's insurance company, may have a self-interest in minimizing the plaintiff's loss (Choice A).

(Choice B) The reference to insurance shows the witness's potential self-interest or bias - an issue that is never collateral (ie, irrelevant). But even if it were, the collateral-evidence rule only bars the use of extrinsic evidence - ie, evidence from sources other than a witness's own testimony - to impeach a witness on such matters.

Educational objective: Evidence of liability insurance coverage is not admissible as substantive proof that a party acted negligently or wrongfully. However, this evidence can be offered for nonsubstantive purposes like impeachment.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 1%，C选项 20%，D选项 77%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

责任保险


(FRE 411) 关于某人是否有责任保险的证据，不可采纳用于证明该人有疏忽或不法行为。责任保险的证据因非实体性目的而可采纳——例如：
  • 为弹劾证人，以证明其有利害关系、偏见或成见
  • 为证明代理、所有权或控制权
FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)

根据《联邦证据规则》第411条，关于某人是否被责任保险所覆盖的证据，不可采纳作为其存在疏忽或不法行为的实体性证据。这有助于确保陪审团不会基于保险存在与否来推断过错，也不会将其裁决建立在被告或保险公司支付能力的基础上。然而，该证据因非实体性目的而是可采纳的——例如，用于弹劾证人。

在本案中，证人是被告保险公司的理赔员这一证言，显示了被告拥有责任保险。因此，该证言不能作为被告存在疏忽的实体性证据被采纳（选项C）。但它可以为弹劾目的而被采纳——例如，用以证明该证人作为被告保险公司的雇员，在最小化原告损失方面可能存在利害关系（选项A）。

（选项B）提及保险显示了证人潜在的利害关系或偏见——这是一个绝非附带（即，非不相关）的问题。但即便如此，附带证据规则仅禁止使用外来证据——即，来自证人自身证言以外的证据来源——就此类事项弹劾证人。

教学目的：关于责任保险覆盖范围的证据，不可采纳作为一方当事人有疏忽或不法行为的实体性证据。然而，该证据可为非实体性目的（如弹劾）而提出。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 411 (liability insurance).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / 证据法

⚖️ 核心规则：FRE 411 责任保险 (Liability Insurance)
证据显示某人是否投保了责任保险，不能用于证明该人行事疏忽 (Negligence) 或有过错 (Wrongful Action)。
法律分析与推理

本题考察的是《联邦证据规则》第411条 (FRE 411) 的细微差别。虽然一般规则禁止提及保险，但该规则包含重要的例外情况。

1. 一般禁止 (General Ban)：
你不能告诉陪审团被告有保险，仅仅是为了暗示“因为他有保险，所以他可能更不小心”或者“反正保险公司会赔钱，判他输也没关系”。这是为了防止陪审团因被告的支付能力而产生偏见。

2. 允许的例外 (Exceptions)：
如果证据是为了其他目的 (Other Purposes)，则是可采纳的 (Admissible)。常见的“其他目的”包括：

  • 证明代理关系、所有权或控制权 (Agency, ownership, or control)
  • 弹劾证人的偏见或成见 (Impeachment for bias or prejudice)
✅ 正确答案：D
Yes, for impeachment purposes only.

解析：在本案中，证人是被告保险公司的理赔员 (Adjuster)。这意味着如果原告胜诉，证人的雇主（保险公司）将遭受经济损失。这直接证明了证人存在经济利益冲突 (Financial Interest) 和潜在的偏见 (Bias)。

原告引入这一证据并非为了证明被告开车疏忽，而是为了攻击证人的可信度（即：他在撒谎或夸大其词，以保护雇主的钱袋子）。这完全符合 FRE 411 的例外情况。
为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误
虽然证据规则确实限制保险证据，但这并非绝对禁止 (Absolute Bar)。当用于弹劾偏见时，它是允许的。
选项 B 错误
附带问题 (Collateral Issue)：通常指与案件核心事实无关的小细节。但在证据法中，偏见 (Bias) 永远不是附带问题。你总是可以通过外部证据 (Extrinsic Evidence) 来证明证人有偏见。
选项 C 错误
实体目的 (Substantive Purposes)：指用来证明案件核心事实（如被告是否闯红灯/疏忽）。FRE 411 明确禁止将保险证据用于证明疏忽。因此，该证据只能用于弹劾，不能用于实体证明。
💡MBE 考试技巧
在处理公共政策排除 (Policy Exclusions) 类题目（如保险、后续补救措施、和解提议）时，关键在于识别证据的用途 (Purpose)：
  • 如果是为了证明责任 (Liability)或过错 (Fault) ➡️ 不可采 (Inadmissible)
  • 如果是为了弹劾 (Impeachment)或证明控制权 (Control) ➡️ 可采 (Admissible)
如果题目问“是否允许”，且存在合法的“其他目的”，通常答案是“允许，但仅限于该特定目的”（通常伴随法官的限制性指示 Limiting Instruction）。

A defendant is on trial for the crime of obstructing justice by concealing records that were subpoenaed in a government investigation. The government calls the defendant's attorney to testify that the defendant contacted the attorney and asked him how to comply with the regulations regarding the transfer of records to a safe-deposit box in Mexico. The defendant's purpose in seeking the attorney's advice was to avoid those restrictions.
Is the attorney's testimony privileged?

choices.a: No, provided the attorney knew the advice was sought for an illegal purpose.
choices.b: No, whether or not the attorney knew the advice was sought for an illegal purpose.
choices.c: Yes, because an attorney is required to keep the confidences of his clients.
choices.d: Yes, because it relates to conduct outside the jurisdiction of the United States.

一名被告因妨碍司法公正罪受审，其罪行是在一次政府调查中藏匿了被传唤的记录。政府传唤被告的律师作证，证言内容为，被告在藏匿记录后，联系了该律师，并询问他如何遵守将记录转移到墨西哥保险箱的相关规定。

该律师的证词是否享有特免权？
options:
A. No, provided the attorney knew the advice was sought for an illegal purpose.
不享有，前提是律师知道该咨询是为非法目的而寻求的。

B. No, whether or not the attorney knew the advice was sought for an illegal purpose.
不享有，无论律师是否知道该咨询是为非法目的而寻求的。

C. Yes, because an attorney is required to keep the confidences of his clients.
享有，因为律师有义务为其客户保密。

D. Yes, because it relates to conduct outside the jurisdiction of the United States.
享有，因为它涉及在美国司法管辖权范围之外的行为。

FiduciaryConstitutes legal advice between corporate fiduciaries & corporation's attorneyStockholders
Joint representationMade during attorney's prior representation of joint clientsAny joint client in subsequent litigation between joint clients
Communications between an attorney and client are privileged and protected from disclosure, discovery, or admission in a legal proceeding if they were:

  • made to obtain legal advice and/or representation and
  • intended to be and kept confidential.


The client holds this privilege, and the attorney cannot disclose (eg, testify to) the confidential communication unless the client waives the privilege. However, when a client seeks legal advice in furtherance of an ongoing or future crime or fraud, this privilege does not apply.

Here, the defendant is charged with obstructing justice by willfully concealing subpoenaed records. She asked her attorney how to transfer the records to a safe-deposit box in Mexico in furtherance of that ongoing crime. Therefore, the attorney's testimony regarding his communication with the defendant is not privileged - whether or not the attorney knew the advice was sought for the illegal purpose of concealing the records (Choice A).

(Choice C) An attorney is required to keep communications with the client confidential, but not when the crime-fraud exception applies.

(Choice D) The attorney's testimony relates to conduct within the jurisdiction of the United States - ie, the defendant's inquiry on how to comply with transfer regulations.

Educational objective:

Confidential attorney-client communications are privileged and therefore protected from disclosure, discovery, or admission. However, this protection does not apply if the client was seeking legal advice in furtherance of an ongoing or future crime or fraud.

选项正确率统计：A选项 55%，B选项 30%（正确选项），C选项 14%，D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

律师-客户特免权的常见例外情况


例外情况律师-客户通讯的用途强制披露方
犯罪-欺诈(Crime-fraud)为促进正在进行或未来的犯罪/欺诈而进行的通讯寻求发现有关犯罪/欺诈信息的一方
已故客户(Deceased client)解决关于已故客户遗嘱意图的争议律师
自我辩护(Self-defense)用于辩护客户对律师提出的渎职或道德指控律师
信托责任(Fiduciary)构成公司受托人与公司律师之间的法律咨询股东
共同代理(Joint representation)在律师先前共同代理客户期间进行的通讯在共同客户之间的后续诉讼中，任何一方共同客户
律师与客户之间的通讯享有特免权，在一个法律程序中受到保护，免于披露、证据开示或采纳，如果这些通讯是：

  • 为了获取法律咨询和/或代理服务并且
  • 意图保密并保持了机密性。


客户持有此项特免权，除非客户放弃该特免权，否则律师不得披露（例如，作证）机密通讯。然而，当客户为促进正在进行或未来的犯罪或欺诈而寻求法律咨询时，此项特免权不适用。

在本案中，被告被指控故意藏匿被传唤的记录，从而妨碍司法公正。她询问其律师如何将记录转移到墨西哥的保险箱，这是为了促进该正在进行的犯罪。因此，律师关于他与被告之间通讯的证词不享有特免权——无论律师是否知道该咨询是为了藏匿记录这一非法目的而寻求的(选项 A)。

(选项 C) 律师有义务为客户的通讯保密，但当犯罪-欺诈例外情况适用时则不然。

(选项 D) 律师的证词涉及美国司法管辖权范围内的行为——即被告关于如何遵守转移规定的询问。

教学目标：

机密的律师-客户通讯享有特免权，因此受到保护，免于披露、证据开示或采纳。然而，如果客户寻求法律咨询是为了促进正在进行或未来的犯罪或欺诈，则此项保护不适用。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 501 (federal common law privileges).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Attorney-Client Privilege
正确答案：B
(不享有特免权，无论律师是否知情)
⚖️ 核心法律规则

犯罪-欺诈例外 (Crime-Fraud Exception)

虽然律师-客户特免权 (Attorney-Client Privilege) 保护机密通讯，但如果客户寻求法律建议是为了协助、促进或实施正在进行的或未来的犯罪/欺诈行为，则该特免权不适用。

🔍 深度解析

本题考察的是特免权失效的一个关键细微差别：谁的意图最重要？

在本案中，被告已经藏匿了记录（这是犯罪行为），但他随后联系律师询问“如何将记录转移到墨西哥”。这不仅仅是承认过去的罪行，而是为了进一步实施或掩盖正在进行的妨碍司法公正 (Obstruction of Justice) 行为。

因此，犯罪-欺诈例外适用，特免权被击穿。

💡 为什么选项 A 是错误的？

这是本题最大的陷阱。选项 A 认为只有律师“知情”时特免权才失效。这是错误的。

判定标准 解释
客户的意图
(Client's Intent)		 ✅ 决定性因素
只要客户利用律师的服务来促进犯罪，特免权即失效。
律师的知情
(Attorney's Knowledge)		 ❌ 无关紧要
律师可以是完全不知情的工具人 (Innocent Pawn)。即使律师认为自己在提供合法的合规建议，只要客户意图非法，特免权依然不存在。
🚫 其他选项排雷
  • 选项 C (一般保密义务)：虽然律师有保密义务，但证据法中的特免权规则（Privilege Rules）高于一般的保密义务。当满足“犯罪-欺诈例外”时，法律强制要求披露，保密义务必须让步。
  • 选项 D (管辖权)：特免权的适用与否取决于通讯的性质，而不是行为发生的地理位置。妨碍美国司法公正的行为，即使涉及将证据移至墨西哥，依然受美国证据法管辖。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理特免权题目时，请务必区分：
  1. 过去的犯罪 (Past Crime)： "我杀了人，我该怎么办？" -> 享有特免权（这是寻求辩护）。
  2. 未来/正在进行的犯罪 (Future/Ongoing Crime)： "我杀了人，我该怎么藏尸体？" -> 无特免权（这是利用律师促进犯罪）。
