questions.question:
In a federal investigation of a man for bank robbery, the grand jury has reason to believe that the man confided in his psychiatrist that he committed the offense. As a result, the grand jury subpoenaed the psychiatrist to testify regarding the man's statement.
The psychiatrist refuses to testify on the ground of privilege.
Can the psychiatrist be forced to testify?

choices.a: No, because the psychiatrist must assert the psychotherapist-patient privilege in the patient's absence.
choices.b: No, because the testimony would violate the man's privilege against self-incrimination.
choices.c: Yes, because the psychotherapist-patient privilege belongs to the man and may only be asserted by him.
choices.d: Yes, because the psychotherapist-patient privilege cannot be invoked at grand jury proceedings.

data.questionStem:
Q87148

In a federal investigation of a man for bank robbery, the grand jury has reason to believe that the man confided in his psychiatrist that he committed the offense. As a result, the grand jury subpoenaed the psychiatrist to testify regarding the man's statement.

The psychiatrist refuses to testify on the ground of privilege.

Can the psychiatrist be forced to testify?

在一起针对一名男子银行抢劫案的联邦调查中，大陪审团有理由相信该男子曾向其精神科医生吐露他实施了该罪行。因此，大陪审团传唤了该精神科医生，要求其就该男子的陈述作证。

该精神科医生以特免权为由拒绝作证。

该精神科医生能被强制要求作证吗？
options:
A. No, because the psychiatrist must assert the psychotherapist-patient privilege in the patient's absence.
不可以，因为在患者缺席的情况下，精神科医生必须主张医患特免权（psychotherapist-patient privilege）。

B. No, because the testimony would violate the man's privilege against self-incrimination.
不可以，因为该证词将侵犯该男子反对自证其罪的特免权。

C. Yes, because the psychotherapist-patient privilege belongs to the man and may only be asserted by him.
可以，因为医患特免权（psychotherapist-patient privilege）属于该男子，并且只能由他本人主张。

D. Yes, because the psychotherapist-patient privilege cannot be invoked at grand jury proceedings.
可以，因为医患特免权（psychotherapist-patient privilege）不能在大陪审团程序中被援引。
data.explanation:
Psychotherapist-patient privilege


Confidential communication between psychotherapist/social worker & patient protected if made during the course of diagnosis or treatment of mental/emotional condition unless :
  • patient's mental condition at issue
  • communication made during court-ordered mental exam
  • communication introduced at involuntary-commitment proceeding
Patient holds privilege & psychotherapist must assert in patient's absence
Under Federal Rule of Evidence 501, claims of privilege in federal court are generally governed by the common law.† For instance, the common law psychotherapist-patient privilege protects confidential communications between a patient and a psychotherapist (ie, psychologist or psychiatrist) or social worker made during the course of treatment or diagnosis. Although this privilege belongs to the patient, the psychotherapist must assert it in the patient's absence - eg, when the patient is not a party to the proceeding (as seen here) (Choice C).

†Common law governs privilege claims in federal court unless (1) the Constitution, a federal statute, or a rule provides otherwise or (2) the suit is based on diversity jurisdiction so state rules on privilege must be applied.

(Choice B) The Fifth Amendment protects a person from being compelled to produce self- incriminating testimonial communications (eg, oral testimony). As a result, this would entitle the psychiatrist to refuse to provide incriminating testimony regarding him/herself - but not regarding the man.

(Choice D) Claims of privilege can be invoked at all stages of a legal proceeding, including grand jury investigations.

Educational objective: The psychotherapist-patient privilege protects confidential communications between a patient and a psychotherapist or social worker made during the course of treatment or diagnosis. This privilege belongs to the patient but must be asserted by the psychotherapist in the patient's absence.

选项正确率统计：A选项 55%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 11%，D选项 30%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

医患特免权 (Psychotherapist-patient privilege)


在精神/情绪状况的诊断或治疗过程中，精神科医生/社会工作者与患者之间的秘密沟通受到保护 除非 :
  • 患者的精神状况成为争议点
  • 沟通发生在法院下令的精神检查期间
  • 沟通在非自愿收容程序中被提出
患者持有特免权，且在患者缺席时，精神科医生必须主张该特免权
根据《联邦证据规则》第501条 (Federal Rule of Evidence 501)，在联邦法院中，特免权的主张通常受普通法管辖。† 例如，普通法中的医患特免权 (psychotherapist-patient privilege) 保护在治疗或诊断过程中，患者与精神科医生（即心理医生或精神病医生）或社会工作者之间的秘密沟通。尽管此特免权属于患者，但精神科医生必须在患者缺席时主张该特免权——例如，当患者不是诉讼程序的一方时（如此案所示）（选项C）。

†在联邦法院中，特免权主张受普通法管辖，除非 (1) 宪法、联邦法规或某项规则另有规定，或 (2) 该诉讼基于多元管辖权 (diversity jurisdiction)，因此必须适用州的特免权规则。

（选项B） 《第五修正案》(Fifth Amendment) 保护任何人不被强迫提供自证其罪的证言性通讯（例如，口头证词）。因此，这会让精神科医生有权拒绝提供有关其自身的罪证，但不能拒绝提供有关该男子的罪证。

（选项D） 特免权的主张可以在法律程序的任何阶段被援引，包括大陪审团的调查。

教学目标：医患特免权（psychotherapist-patient privilege）保护在治疗或诊断过程中，患者与精神科医生或社会工作者之间的秘密沟通。此特免权属于患者，但精神科医生必须在患者缺席时主张该特免权。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 501 (applicability of common law privileges).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：特免权与大陪审团

正确答案：A 不可以强制其作证。
因为在患者缺席的情况下，精神科医生有义务代表患者主张“心理治疗师-患者特免权” (Psychotherapist-Patient Privilege)。

⚖️ 核心法律规则

本题考察的是联邦证据法下的特免权适用范围及主张方式。主要涉及以下三个关键点：

1. 联邦特免权的承认 (Recognition)
根据 Jaffee v. Redmond (1996) 判例，联邦法院依据普通法承认“心理治疗师-患者特免权”。这保护了患者与精神科医生、心理学家及持照社工之间为了诊断或治疗目的而进行的保密沟通 (Confidential Communications)。
2. 大陪审团的适用性 (Grand Jury Applicability)
这是MBE常考陷阱。根据《联邦证据规则》第1101条 (FRE 1101)，大多数证据规则（如传闻证据规则 Hearsay）不适用于大陪审团程序，但是特免权规则 (Rules on Privilege) 依然适用。
3. 谁来主张？(Who asserts?)
特免权属于患者 (Patient)。但是，如果患者不在场（如本题中的大陪审团听证会），心理治疗师不仅有权，而且必须 (Must) 代表患者主张该特免权，除非患者明确放弃。

🔍 选项深度解析

选项 A (正确) 理由： 题目中患者（嫌疑人）并未出席大陪审团程序。作为特免权的持有者，患者不在场时，医生作为其受托人，必须拒绝回答涉及保密沟通的问题。
选项 B (错误) 理由： 混淆了概念。第五修正案的“反对自证其罪” (Privilege Against Self-Incrimination) 是个人的 (Personal)。医生作证会指控患者，而不是医生自己，因此医生不能援引第五修正案来拒绝作证。
选项 C (错误) 理由： 这是一个常见的误导项。虽然特免权确实属于患者，但这并不意味着只能由患者亲自张嘴主张。法律允许（并要求）医生在患者缺席时代表其行使这一权利。
选项 D (错误) 理由： 这是一个关于法律适用范围的错误。如前所述，特免权是少数几个在大陪审团程序中依然有效的证据规则之一。
💡 MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理 Evidence 题目时，如果看到 Grand Jury (大陪审团)：

  • 首先反应：Hearsay（传闻证据）可以进，无关证据可以进。
  • 但是！ Privilege（特免权）绝对受到保护。

如果题目涉及医生、律师或配偶拒绝在大陪审团作证，通常是因为特免权生效。

questions.question:
A defendant has been charged with making a false statement to a federally insured financial institution to secure a loan. At trial, the prosecutor calls the defendant's wife as a willing witness to testify that the defendant told her in confidence that he had misrepresented his assets on the loan application.
The defendant objects to his wife's testimony. Should the testimony be admitted?

choices.a: No, because even though the wife is a willing witness, the defendant has the right to exclude confidential marital communications in federal court.
choices.b: No, but only if the law of the state where the defendant and his wife reside recognizes a privilege for confidential marital communications.
choices.c: Yes, because in federal court the right not to testify belongs to the testifying spouse, and she is a willing witness.
choices.d: Yes, because while the adverse testimonial privilege is recognized in federal court, the marital communications privilege is not.

data.questionStem:
Q87824 A defendant has been charged with making a false statement to a federally insured financial institution to secure a loan. At trial, the prosecutor calls the defendant's wife as a willing witness to testify that the defendant told her in confidence that he had misrepresented his assets on the loan application.

The defendant objects to his wife's testimony. Should the testimony be admitted? 一名被告被指控向一家有联邦保险的金融机构作出虚假陈述以获取贷款。在审判中，检察官传唤被告的妻子作为自愿证人，以证明被告曾私下告诉她，他在贷款申请中虚报了自己的资产。

被告反对其妻子的证词。该证词是否应被采纳？
options:
A. No, because even though the wife is a willing witness, the defendant has the right to exclude confidential marital communications in federal court.
不应采纳，因为即使妻子是自愿作证的证人，被告在联邦法院仍有权排除保密的婚姻内交流。

B. No, but only if the law of the state where the defendant and his wife reside recognizes a privilege for confidential marital communications.
不应采纳，但前提是被告及其妻子居住州的法律承认保密的婚姻内交流特免权。

C. Yes, because in federal court the right not to testify belongs to the testifying spouse, and she is a willing witness.
应采纳，因为在联邦法院，不作证的权利属于作证配偶，而她是自愿作证的证人。

D. Yes, because while the adverse testimonial privilege is recognized in federal court, the marital communications privilege is not.
应采纳，因为虽然联邦法院承认配偶不利证言特免权，但不承认婚姻内交流特免权。
data.explanation:
Spousal privileges


PurposePrivilege holderDuration
Spousal-immunityShields witness-spouse from testifying against spouse in criminal case about matters that occurred before or during marriageWitness-spouseOnly during active marriage
Marital-communicationsProtects against disclosure of confidential spousal communications made during marriage in criminal & civil casesBoth spousesContinues after divorce
In federal court, claims of privilege are generally governed by the common law. Two common law privileges apply to spousal testimony:

Spousal-immunity (ie, adverse-testimony) privilege – allows a person to refuse to testify against his/her spouse in a criminal case about any matter that occurred before or during marriage

Marital-communications privilege – protects confidential communications between spouses during the marriage from disclosure, discovery, or admission in criminal and civil cases (Choice D)

The spousal-immunity privilege belongs only to the witness-spouse, who can choose to waive the privilege and testify against the defendant-spouse (as seen here). But the marital-communications privilege belongs to both spouses, so one spouse can prevent the other from disclosing a confidential communication. Therefore, the wife's testimony about confidential marital communications should be excluded on this basis (Choice C).

(Choice B) Federal common law privileges apply in federal cases except (1) when the Constitution, a federal statute, or a Supreme Court rule provides otherwise or (2) in diversity cases, where the rules of the state where the court (not the parties) sits will apply. Neither exception applies to this federal criminal case.

Educational objective:
Under the spousal-immunity (ie, adverse-testimony) privilege, a witness-spouse can refuse to testify against his/her spouse in a criminal case about any matter. Under the marital-communications privilege, both spouses can protect confidential communications during marriage from disclosure, discovery, or admission in all cases.

配偶特免权


目的特免权持有人持续时间
配偶豁免权在刑事案件中，保护证人配偶免于就婚姻前或婚姻期间发生的事项作出不利于其配偶的证词证人配偶仅在有效婚姻存续期间
婚姻内交流特免权在刑事和民事案件中，保护婚姻期间作出的保密配偶交流不被披露配偶双方离婚后继续有效
在联邦法院，特免权的主张通常受普通法管辖。有两种普通法特免权适用于配偶证词：

配偶豁免权（即，配偶不利证言特免权）– 允许个人在刑事案件中，就婚姻前或婚姻期间发生的任何事项，拒绝作出不利于其配偶的证词

婚姻内交流特免权 – 在刑事和民事案件中，保护婚姻存续期间配偶之间的保密交流不被披露、证据开示或采纳（选项 D）

配偶豁免权仅属于证人配偶，其可以选择放弃该特免权并作证指控被告配偶（如本案所示）。但是，婚姻内交流特免权属于配偶双方，因此一方配偶可以阻止另一方披露保密的交流内容。因此，基于此理由，妻子的关于保密婚姻内交流的证词应当被排除（选项 C）。

（选项 B）联邦普通法特免权适用于联邦案件，除非（1）宪法、联邦法规或最高法院规则另有规定，或（2）在多元管辖权案件中，将适用法院（而非当事人）所在州的规则。本联邦刑事案件不适用任何一项例外情况。

教学目的：
根据配偶豁免权（即，配偶不利证言特免权），证人配偶可以在刑事案件中拒绝就任何事项作证指控其配偶。根据婚姻内交流特免权，配偶双方可以在所有案件中保护婚姻期间的保密交流不被披露、证据开示或采纳。

References
Fed. R. Evid. 501 (privilege in general).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Spousal Privileges

💡 核心考点：区分两种配偶特免权 本题的陷阱在于混淆了联邦法院承认的两种截然不同的配偶特免权：
  1. 配偶豁免权 (Spousal Immunity)
  2. 婚姻交流特免权 (Marital Communications Privilege)

在联邦刑事案件中（根据 Fed. R. Evid. 501 和普通法），两者的关键区别如下：

特征 配偶豁免权
(Spousal Immunity)		 婚姻交流特免权
(Marital Communications)
保护范围 拒绝出庭作证指控配偶 拒绝披露保密交流 (Confidential Communications)
权利持有人
(Holder)		 仅限证人配偶
(Witness-Spouse)		 双方配偶
(Both Spouses)
适用案件 仅限刑事案件 民事与刑事案件
婚姻状态 审判时必须已婚 交流时必须已婚
(离婚后仍有效)

⚖️ 案情逻辑推演

第一步：确定适用法律
这是一个联邦刑事案件（虚假陈述获取联邦保险贷款）。根据 Fed. R. Evid. 501，特免权适用联邦普通法 (Federal Common Law)。

第二步：分析“配偶豁免权”
检察官传唤妻子，妻子是自愿证人 (Willing Witness)。根据最高法院在 Trammel v. United States 中的判例，配偶豁免权属于证人。既然妻子愿意作证，被告丈夫无权基于此特免权阻止她上证人席。

第三步：分析“婚姻交流特免权”
证词内容是被告在婚姻期间私下 (in confidence) 告诉妻子的关于犯罪的事实。这属于保密的婚姻交流。该特免权的持有人是双方。这意味着，即使妻子愿意披露，被告丈夫作为另一方持有人，仍有权行使否决权，禁止该特定内容的披露。

选项 A 正确 不应采纳。虽然妻子自愿作证（放弃了配偶豁免权），但被告仍持有“婚姻交流特免权”，有权排除关于婚姻期间保密交流的证词。
选项 B 错误 法律适用错误。联邦刑事案件中的特免权由联邦普通法管辖，而不是州法（State Law）。州法仅在联邦法院审理的民事案件且基于多元管辖权 (Diversity Jurisdiction) 时才适用。
选项 C 错误 混淆概念。该选项描述的是“配偶豁免权”（即不作证的权利属于证人）。但这忽略了被告仍拥有独立的“婚姻交流特免权”来保护具体的谈话内容。
选项 D 错误 法律认知错误。联邦法院同时承认这两种特免权。认为联邦法院不承认婚姻交流特免权是错误的。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)
看到配偶作证题，先问自己：
1. 是为了阻止配偶上台？(看证人意愿)
2. 还是为了阻止配偶说悄悄话？(被告可阻止)
本题中，妻子愿意上台，但丈夫可以捂住她的嘴不让她说悄悄话。

questions.question:
A plaintiff, the owner of a motel chain, brought a breach-of-contract action against a defendant, a construction company, in federal court. The plaintiff alleged that the defendant's poor workmanship in constructing the plaintiff's new motel led to major defects in the motel's foundation. The plaintiff further alleged that the defendant knew about the defects but willfully concealed them.
During settlement negotiations, the defendant produced a quality control report that it had created during the motel's construction but had not previously shared with the plaintiff. The report indicated that the defendant was aware of the foundation defects, and it included an estimate on the cost of repair. The defendant relied on the report during the settlement negotiations in order to justify its settlement offer; however, no settlement was reached.
At trial, the plaintiff seeks to introduce the quality control report to establish the issue of willful concealment.
Is the report admissible?

choices.a: No, because all statements made during settlement negotiations are inadmissible.
choices.b: No, because the report is hearsay not within any exception.
choices.c: Yes, because statements made in settlement negotiations are admissible when offered to prove the validity of a claim.
choices.d: Yes, because the report was created for purposes other than settlement negotiations and is otherwise admissible.

The plaintiff alleged that the defendant's poor workmanship in constructing the plaintiff's new motel led to major defects in the motel's foundation. The plaintiff further alleged that the defendant knew about the defects but willfully concealed them.

The report indicated that the defendant was aware of the foundation defects, and it included an estimate on the cost of repair. The defendant relied on the report during the settlement negotiations in order to justify its settlement offer; however, no settlement was reached.

At trial, the plaintiff seeks to introduce the quality control report to establish the issue of willful concealment.

Is the report admissible?

原告是一家连锁汽车旅馆的所有人，在联邦法院对被告（一家建筑公司）提起了违约诉讼。原告指控，被告在建造原告的新汽车旅馆时工艺低劣，导致旅馆地基出现重大缺陷。原告进一步指控，被告明知这些缺陷却故意隐瞒。

在和解谈判期间，被告出示了一份其在汽车旅馆建造期间制作、但此前未与原告分享的质量控制报告。该报告表明被告意识到了地基缺陷，并包含了维修费用的估算。被告在和解谈判中依赖该报告为其和解要约提供理由；然而，双方并未达成和解。

在审判中，原告试图引入该质量控制报告，以证明故意隐瞒的问题。

该报告是否可采纳？
options:
A. No, because all statements made during settlement negotiations are inadmissible.
否，因为在和解谈判期间所作的所有陈述都是不可采纳的。

B. No, because the report is hearsay not within any exception.
否，因为该报告是传闻证据，且不属于任何例外情况。

C. Yes, because statements made in settlement negotiations are admissible when offered to prove the validity of a claim.
是，因为在和解谈判中所作的陈述，若用于证明一项主张的有效性，则是可采纳的。

D. Yes, because the report was created for purposes other than settlement negotiations and is otherwise admissible.
是，因为该报告是为和解谈判以外的目的而创建的，且在其他方面是可采纳的。
data.explanation:
Compromise offers & negotiations
(FRE 408)


Applicability
  • Offers made with intent to compromise (ie, avoid or end) claim
  • Conduct/statements made during compromise negotiations about claim
Prohibited useNot admissible to:
  • prove/disprove validity or amount of disputed claim or
  • impeach by prior inconsistent statement or contradiction
ExceptionsConduct/statements admissible for above purposes if:
  • made during negotiations in civil dispute involving government regulatory, investigative, or enforcement agency and offered in subsequent criminal case
Admissible for other purpose - eg:
  • proving witness's bias or prejudice
  • negating contention of undue delay
  • proving effort to obstruct criminal investigation or prosecution
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Federal Rule of Evidence (FRE) 408 is an exclusionary rule designed to encourage compromise and settlement of disputes. As a result, the following evidence is generally not admissible to prove/disprove the validity or amount of a disputed claim OR to impeach a witness with a prior inconsistent statement:
  • Offers of compromise made with the intent to avoid or settle the claim
  • Conduct or statements made during compromise or settlement negotiations
However, FRE 408 does not apply to evidence created for reasons other than settlement, so a party cannot immunize evidence from admission merely by producing it during settlement negotiations (Choice A). Accordingly, evidence created for nonsettlement reasons is admissible so long as it is not barred by another rule (eg, the rule against hearsay). Here, the quality control report was created during the motel's construction and before settlement negotiations were ever contemplated. Therefore, the report is not barred under FRE 408.†

Nor is the report barred by the rule against hearsay, under which out-of-court statements are not admissible to prove the truth of the matter asserted therein. That is because out-of-court statements that are made by a party-opponent (eg, the defendant's report) and offered against that party are excluded from this rule and considered nonhearsay (Choice B). Since there is no other basis for exclusion, the report is admissible.

†In contrast, a similar report made for settlement negotiations would be subject to the limitations set forth in FRE 408.

(Choice C) Statements made during settlement negotiations are not always admissible to prove a claim's validity. Such statements are inadmissible for this purpose unless (1) made during negotiations in a civil dispute involving a government regulatory, investigative, or enforcement agency and (2) offered in a subsequent criminal case.

Educational objective: Statements made during settlement negotiations are generally inadmissible to prove/disprove the validity of a claim or impeach a party with a prior inconsistent statement. But a party cannot immunize evidence created for reasons other than settlement from admission merely by producing the evidence during settlement negotiations.

选项正确率统计：A选项 18%，B选项 4%，C选项 9%，D选项 67%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

和解要约与谈判
(FRE 408)


适用性
  • 为达成和解（即避免或终止）主张而提出的要约
  • 在关于主张的和解谈判中所作的行为/陈述
禁止用途不可采纳用于：
  • 证明/反驳有争议主张的有效性或金额 或者
  • 以先前不一致的陈述或矛盾之处进行弹劾
例外情况在以下情况下，行为/陈述可为上述目的而采纳：
  • 在涉及政府监管、调查或执法机构的民事纠纷谈判中作出 并且 在后续的刑事案件中提出
可为其他目的采纳 - 例如：
  • 证明证人的偏见或成见
  • 反驳关于不当延迟的论点
  • 证明妨碍刑事调查或起诉的企图
FRE = 联邦证据规则 (Federal Rule of Evidence)。

联邦证据规则 (FRE) 408 是一项排除性规则，旨在鼓励争议的和解与解决。因此，以下证据通常不可采纳用以证明/反驳有争议主张的有效性或金额，或用先前的非一致性陈述弹劾证人：
  • 为避免或解决主张而提出的和解要约
  • 在和解或解决谈判期间所作的行为或陈述
然而，FRE 408 不适用于为和解以外的原因而创建的证据，因此一方当事人不能仅仅通过在和解谈判中出示证据就使其免于被采纳 (选项 A)。因此，只要不被其他规则（例如，反对传闻证据的规则）所禁止，为非和解原因创建的证据就是可采纳的。在本案中，质量控制报告是在汽车旅馆建设期间创建的，并且是在考虑进行和解谈判之前。因此，该报告不受 FRE 408 的禁止。†

该报告也不被反对传闻证据的规则所禁止，根据该规则，庭外陈述不可被采纳以证明其所主张事项的真实性。这是因为由对方当事人（例如，被告的报告）作出并用于对抗该方的庭外陈述，被排除在该规则之外，并被视为非传闻证据 (选项 B)。由于没有其他排除的理由，该报告是可采纳的。

†相比之下，为和解谈判而制作的类似报告将受到 FRE 408 中规定的限制。

(选项 C) 在和解谈判中所作的陈述并非总是可采纳以证明主张的有效性。此类陈述为此目的不可采纳，除非 (1) 是在涉及政府监管、调查或执法机构的民事纠纷谈判中作出，并且 (2) 在后续的刑事案件中提出。

教学目标： 在和解谈判期间所作的陈述通常不可采纳，以证明/反驳主张的有效性或用先前不一致的陈述来弹劾一方当事人。但是，一方当事人不能仅仅通过在和解谈判中出示为和解以外原因创建的证据，就使其免于被采纳。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 408 (compromise offers and negotiations).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence (证据法) - FRE 408
核心考点：FRE 408 (Compromise Offers and Negotiations)

联邦证据规则第408条通常禁止引入和解谈判中的陈述或行为来证明责任。但是，该规则不保护那些“为和解以外的目的而创建”的证据，即使这些证据是在和解谈判中被出示的。

✅ 正确答案分析 (选项 D)

本题的关键在于区分“谈判中的陈述”与“先前存在的证据”。

逻辑推理：

  1. 时间点关键：该质量控制报告 (Quality Control Report) 是在汽车旅馆建造期间制作的。
  2. 目的关键：制作该报告时，双方尚未发生诉讼，也没有进行和解谈判。它是为了工程质量控制这一“非和解目的”而存在的。
  3. 法律适用：FRE 408 不能被用来“清洗”或“豁免” (Immunize) 那些原本可采纳的证据。如果一份文件在诉讼前就已经存在且可采纳，被告不能仅仅通过在和解谈判桌上把它拿出来，就使其变得不可采纳。

因此，该报告不受 FRE 408 的排除规则限制，且符合相关性要求，故可采纳 (Admissible)。

❌ 干扰项排除
选项 A 错误： 虽然 FRE 408 确实排除了谈判期间的陈述，但它并不排除在谈判前就已经存在的实物证据或文件。此选项过于绝对。
选项 B 错误 (传闻证据陷阱)： 虽然报告是庭外陈述，但它是对方当事人陈述 (Opposing Party's Statement)。根据 FRE 801(d)(2)，这类陈述被定义为非传闻 (Non-hearsay)，而不是传闻的例外。因此，它不受传闻规则的阻碍。
选项 C 错误： 这是一个错误的法律陈述。FRE 408 的核心目的正是禁止使用和解谈判中的陈述来证明主张的有效性 (Validity of the claim)。
🎓 MBE 拿分技巧：

遇到涉及和解谈判 (Settlement Negotiations) 的题目时，请自问：
“这个证据是专门为谈判说的/写的，还是谈判前就已经存在的？”

如果是先前存在的文件 (Pre-existing document)，即使在谈判中被提及或出示，FRE 408 也不会将其屏蔽。当事人不能利用和解谈判来隐藏原本对他不利的证据（Smoking Gun）。

questions.question:
Police received a tip from an informant that a man that lived on his street might be dealing drugs out of his home. An investigation was initiated in response to the informant's tip. During the investigation, an undercover officer purchased cocaine from the man at his home on multiple occasions. Police ultimately obtained a valid warrant to search the man's home and, while executing the warrant, found a large quantity of cocaine. The man was subsequently charged with knowingly possessing cocaine with the intent to distribute.
Prior to trial, the man requested disclosure of the identity of the informant and the contents of the informant's statement to police. The prosecutor refused to disclose the informant's identity and the substance of the informant's statement to police, claiming that both are privileged.
How should the court rule on the prosecutor's privilege claims?

choices.a: Both the identity of the informant and the contents of the informant's statement to police are privileged.
choices.b: Only the contents of the informant's statement to police are privileged.
choices.c: Only the identity of the informant is privileged.
choices.d: Neither the identity of the informant nor the contents of the informant's statement to police are privileged.

questions.question:
A defendant is on trial for tax evasion. The prosecutor, seeking to establish the defendant's income by showing his expenditures, has asked the defendant's attorney to produce records showing only how much the defendant had paid his attorney in fees.
Should the demand for the attorney's fee records be upheld?

choices.a: No, because the records are protected by the attorney work-product doctrine.
choices.b: No, because the records are protected by the attorney-client privilege.
choices.c: Yes, because it calls for relevant information not within the attorney-client privilege.
choices.d: Yes, because the attorney-client privilege cannot be invoked to conceal evidence of a crime.

Q87158

A defendant is on trial for tax evasion. The prosecutor, seeking to establish the defendant's income by showing his expenditures, has asked the defendant's attorney to produce records showing only how much the defendant had paid his attorney in fees.

Should the demand for the attorney's fee records be upheld?

一名被告因逃税罪正在受审。检察官为通过显示被告的支出来确定其收入，已要求被告的律师出示仅显示被告支付给其律师费用的记录。

对律师费记录的要求是否应得到支持？
options:
A. No, because the records are protected by the attorney work-product doctrine.
不应支持，因为这些记录受到律师工作成果原则的保护。

B. No, because the records are protected by the attorney-client privilege.
不应支持，因为这些记录受到律师-当事人特权的保护。

C. Yes, because it calls for relevant information not within the attorney-client privilege.
应支持，因为它要求提供不属于律师-当事人特权范围内的相关信息。

D. Yes, because the attorney-client privilege cannot be invoked to conceal evidence of a crime.
应支持，因为律师-当事人特权不能被援引来隐藏犯罪证据。
data.explanation:
Attorney-client privileged communications


(FRE 502)

Any communication between attorney & client:
PrivilegedNot privileged
made to obtain legal advice/representation and intended to be & kept confidential
  • Purely factual information
  • Client's identity (generally)
  • Existence of attorney-client relationship
  • Client's legal fees & other incidentals
  • Attorney's fee records
  • Business advice or opinions
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.

Attorney-client communications are privileged if they are (1) made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice and/or representation and (2) intended to be and kept confidential. As a result, communications that are merely incidental to providing legal advice or representation (eg, attorney's fee records) are not privileged (Choice B). These nonprivileged communications are therefore subject to disclosure, discovery, and admission in a legal proceeding so long as they are relevant to the case.

Here, the attorney's fee records are not privileged because they are merely incidental to the attorney's representation. And since they are relevant to the defendant's personal income and expenditures in this tax-evasion case, the demand for the attorney's fee records should be upheld.

(Choice A) The attorney work-product doctrine protects materials prepared by an attorney or client in anticipation of litigation - eg, attorney's impressions, opinions, or research. But the amount a client paid his attorney for legal representation is outside the protection of this doctrine.

(Choice D) The attorney-client privilege can be invoked to conceal confidential communications regarding a past (not ongoing or planned) crime or fraud. But this privilege does not apply to records regarding attorney fees.

Educational objective: Attorney-client communications are privileged if (1) made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice/representation and (2) intended to be and kept confidential. Communications that are merely incidental to the client's legal representation do not fall within this privilege.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 16%，C选项 78%（正确选项），D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

律师-当事人特权通讯


(FRE 502)

律师与当事人之间的任何通讯：
享有特权不享有特权
为获取法律咨询/代理而作出 并且 意图保密并已保密的通讯
  • 纯粹的事实信息
  • 当事人的身份（通常情况下）
  • 律师-当事人关系的存在
  • 当事人的律师费及其他杂费
  • 律师费记录
  • 商业建议或意见
FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence（联邦证据规则）。

律师-当事人通讯在以下情况下享有特权：（1）为了获取法律咨询和/或代理而作出，并且（2）意图保密并已保持保密。因此，仅为提供法律咨询或代理而附带发生的通讯（例如，律师费记录）不享有特权（选项B）。因此，只要这些不享有特权的通讯与案件相关，就可以在法律程序中被披露、证据开示和采纳。

在本案中，律师费记录不享有特权，因为它们仅仅是律师代理服务中的附带事项。并且，由于在本逃税案中，这些记录与被告的个人收入和支出相关，因此对律师费记录的要求应得到支持。

（选项A）律师工作成果原则保护律师或当事人为准备诉讼而制作的材料——例如，律师的印象、意见或研究。但是，当事人为法律代理向其律师支付的费用金额不在此原则的保护范围之内。

（选项D）律师-当事人特权可以被援引，以隐藏有关过去的（非正在进行或计划中的）犯罪或欺诈行为的保密通讯。但此特权不适用于有关律师费的记录。

教学目的：律师-当事人通讯在以下情况下享有特权：（1）为了获取法律咨询/代理而作出，并且（2）意图保密并已保持保密。仅为当事人的法律代理而附带发生的通讯不属于此特权的范围。

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Privilege
✅ 正确答案：选项 C

本题的核心考点在于区分受保护的法律咨询与不受保护的附带事实。

⚖️ 核心法律规则解析
律师-当事人特权 (Attorney-Client Privilege)
该特权旨在保护客户为了寻求法律建议而与律师进行的保密通讯 (Confidential Communications)。

然而，并非所有与律师的互动都属于“特权通讯”。联邦法院普遍认定以下信息通常不享有特权：

  • 客户的身份 (Client Identity)
  • 律师费用的支付安排 (Fee Arrangements)
  • 支付的金额 (Amount of Fees Paid)
  • 案件的基本事实 (Underlying Facts)
💡 逻辑推导：
支付律师费被视为一种商业交易行为或代理关系的附带后果 (Incidental to representation)，而非为了获取法律建议而进行的“通讯”。

在本案中，检察官要求的是费用记录 (Fee Records)。这些记录仅显示被告支付了多少钱，不涉及被告向律师咨询的具体法律内容或律师提供的建议。因此，这些记录不属于特权范围。

❌ 干扰项排除
选项 A 错误 律师工作成果 (Work-Product Doctrine)
该原则保护的是律师为准备诉讼而形成的思维过程、策略、备忘录等 (Mental impressions, conclusions, opinions)。单纯的收费记录不包含律师的法律策略，因此不受此保护。
选项 B 错误 律师-当事人特权 (Attorney-Client Privilege)
如上所述，费用记录通常被视为非特权信息。除非披露费用会直接暴露法律咨询的实质内容（极少数例外情况），否则该选项不成立。
选项 D 错误 犯罪-欺诈例外 (Crime-Fraud Exception)
虽然特权确实不能用于掩盖犯罪，但这个选项的推理逻辑是多余的。我们不需要动用“犯罪-欺诈例外”来强行突破特权，因为特权从一开始就不存在（即费用记录本身就不是特权信息）。
🎓 MBE 备考锦囊

在处理 Evidence (证据法) 中的特权问题时，请记住以下公式：

特权 = 通讯 (Communication) + 保密意图 (Confidentiality) + 法律咨询目的 (Legal Purpose)

如果题目问的是关于律师的行政性事务（如：谁是客户？付了多少钱？什么时候见的面？），这些通常属于事实 (Facts)，而非受保护的通讯。

In response, the attorney plans to testify to communications that the attorney made in meetings with the plaintiff regarding an alternative defense strategy, which they agreed to pursue. The plaintiff objects to the attorney's testimony, invoking the attorney-client privilege.

Should the court uphold the client's privilege claim?

一名原告，同时也是一家五金店的店主，在输掉了一场涉及其五金店售出的缺陷产品的诉讼后，以执业不当为由起诉了她的律师。原告声称，该律师因缺乏足够的专业知识而疏忽地处理了辩护。在审理中，原告为证明律师的过失，出示了一封由律师写给原告的信函，信中概述了一个律师未在庭审中使用的常用诉讼策略。作为回应，律师计划就其与原告在会面中商讨的、双方同意采用的替代辩护策略进行作证。原告援引律师-当事人特免权，反对律师的证词。

法院是否应支持当事人的特免权主张？
options:
A. No, because the attorney's professional relationship with the plaintiff has ended.
不应支持，因为律师与原告的职业关系已经终止。

B. No, because the statement is not protected by the attorney-client privilege.
不应支持，因为该陈述不受律师-当事人特免权的保护。

C. Yes, because only the client, as the holder of the privilege, can waive it.
应支持，因为只有作为特免权持有人的当事人才能放弃该权利。

D. Yes, because the communications were made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice and intended to be kept confidential.
应支持，因为该沟通是为了获取法律建议而进行的，并且意图保密。

Common exceptions to attorney-client privilege


ExceptionUse of attorney-client communicationDisclosure compelled by
Crime-fraudMade to further ongoing or future crime/fraudParty seeking to discover information about crime/fraud
Deceased clientResolves dispute over deceased client's testamentary intentAttorney
Self-defenseUsed to defend against client's malpractice or ethical claim against attorneyAttorney
FiduciaryConstitutes legal advice between corporate fiduciaries & corporation's attorneyStockholders
Joint representationMade during attorney's prior representation of joint clientsAny joint client in subsequent litigation between joint clients
The attorney-client privilege protects confidential communications between an attorney and a client that were made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice or representation. However, one exception to this privilege applies to communications that are relevant to an ongoing dispute between the attorney and the client (eg, malpractice action). In such cases, the attorney may disclose any confidential communications that are relevant to the attorney's defense on the disputed issue without the client's consent.

Here, the attorney plans to testify about confidential communications that he made during meetings with the plaintiff (client) regarding an alternative defense strategy (legal advice). But since these communications are relevant to establishing the attorney's defense in this ongoing malpractice dispute, the attorney-client privilege does not apply (Choice D). Therefore, the court should deny the client's privilege claim.

(Choice A) The privilege remains in effect even after the attorney-client relationship has ended (as seen here) or the client dies. Therefore, this would not be a basis for denying the plaintiff's privilege claim.

(Choice C) The attorney-client privilege can be waived by the client directly or by an attorney or other agent acting with the client's authority. But here, the client's waiver is unnecessary since the attorney-client privilege does not apply.

Educational objective: Attorney-client communications are not privileged if they are relevant to an ongoing dispute between the attorney and the client. Therefore, the attorney may disclose these communications without the client's consent.

律师-当事人特免权的常见例外情况


例外情况律师-当事人沟通的使用强制披露方
犯罪-欺诈为助长正在进行或未来的犯罪/欺诈而进行的沟通寻求发现有关犯罪/欺诈信息的当事方
已故当事人解决有关已故当事人遗嘱意图的争议律师
自我辩护用于辩护当事人对律师提出的执业不当或道德指控律师
受托人构成公司受托人与公司律师之间的法律建议股东
共同代理在律师先前对共同当事人的代理期间进行的沟通在共同当事人之间随后的诉讼中的任何一方共同当事人
律师-当事人特免权保护律师与当事人之间为获取法律建议或代理而进行的保密沟通。然而，该特免权的一个例外适用于与律师和当事人之间正在进行的争议（例如，执业不当诉讼）相关的沟通。在此类情况下，律师可以披露任何与律师在该争议问题上的辩护相关的保密沟通，而无需征得当事人的同意。

在本案中，律师计划就其在与原告（当事人）会面期间，关于替代辩护策略（法律建议）的保密沟通进行作证。但由于这些沟通与在此次正在进行的执业不当争议中确立律师的辩护相关，因此律师-当事人特免权不适用(选项 D)。因此，法院应驳回当事人的特免权主张。

(选项 A) 即使在律师-当事人关系终止（如本案所示）或当事人去世后，特免权仍然有效。因此，这不能作为驳回原告特免权主张的依据。

(选项 C) 律师-当事人特免权可由当事人直接放弃，或由经当事人授权的律师或其他代理人放弃。但在本案中，由于律师-当事人特免权不适用，当事人放弃该权利并非必要。

教学目的：如果律师与当事人之间的沟通与双方正在进行的争议相关，则该沟通不受特免权保护。因此，律师可以未经当事人同意而披露这些沟通内容。

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Attorney-Client Privilege

🎯 核心考点：自我辩护例外

当律师被当事人（Client）起诉执业不当（Malpractice）时，律师-当事人特免权（Attorney-Client Privilege）不再适用。律师有权披露相关的保密沟通以进行自我辩护。

⚖️ 法律规则解析

律师-当事人特免权 (Attorney-Client Privilege) 通常保护律师与当事人之间为了获取法律建议而进行的保密沟通。但是，这一特权并非绝对，存在几个重要的例外。

自我辩护例外 (Self-Defense Exception):

如果律师与当事人之间发生法律纠纷（例如：当事人起诉律师失职，或律师起诉当事人追讨律师费），特免权对于与该纠纷相关的沟通不再适用。

背后的逻辑：

法律不允许当事人将特免权既作为“矛”（起诉律师）又作为“盾”（阻止律师解释其行为）。当事人一旦将律师的代理行为置于争议之中，就视为放弃了相关沟通的保密性。

📊 特免权的常见例外 (Exceptions)
例外类型 说明
自我辩护
Self-Defense		 律师与当事人之间的纠纷（如本题）。
犯罪/欺诈
Crime-Fraud		 寻求法律建议以协助实施未来的犯罪或欺诈。
共同当事人
Joint Clients		 两名当事人曾由同一律师代理，后来双方发生诉讼，之前的沟通对彼此无特免权。
📝 选项深度解析
正确答案 B 不应支持，因为该陈述不受律师-当事人特免权的保护。

这是对规则的直接应用。由于原告（当事人）起诉律师执业不当，这触发了“自我辩护例外”。因此，关于辩护策略的沟通在此时不再受特免权保护，律师可以作证以证明自己没有过失。

选项 A 错误 理由：关系终止。

这是一个常见的干扰项。律师-当事人特免权是永久的（perpetual），即使代理关系结束甚至当事人死亡，特免权通常依然存在。本题的关键在于“例外”，而不是关系的结束。

选项 C 错误 理由：只有当事人能放弃。

虽然通常只有当事人（Holder）能放弃（Waive）特免权，但本题适用的不是“放弃”，而是“例外”（Exception）。当例外适用时，特免权根本就不存在，因此不需要当事人的同意。

选项 D 错误 理由：符合特免权的一般定义。

这个选项描述了特免权的一般规则（为了获取法律建议而保密沟通）。但在本题的特定情境下（执业不当诉讼），这一规则被例外情况所覆盖。

A plaintiff brought a diversity action in State A federal court against a defendant, a spinal surgeon, alleging medical malpractice. The plaintiff claims that the defendant ignored established medical guidelines while performing a procedure on the plaintiff, causing her ongoing and debilitating back pain. The defendant contends that the plaintiff's back pain is attributable to her failure to follow recovery instructions. The defendant has filed a motion to compel production of medical records from the plaintiff's family physician that contain a statement by the plaintiff that her back pain began after she picked up her child against the defendant's recovery instructions. The plaintiff has objected, citing the physician-patient privilege recognized under State A law.
Should the court uphold the plaintiff's privilege claim?

choices.a: No, because the physician-patient privilege is not applicable in federal proceedings.
choices.b: No, because the plaintiff's physical condition is at issue.
choices.c: Yes, because State A recognizes the physician-patient privilege.
choices.d: Yes, provided the statement was made for the purpose of obtaining medical treatment.

Q87136

A plaintiff brought a diversity action in State A federal court against a defendant, a spinal surgeon, alleging medical malpractice. The plaintiff claims that the defendant ignored established medical guidelines while performing a procedure on the plaintiff, causing her ongoing and debilitating back pain. The defendant contends that the plaintiff's back pain is attributable to her failure to follow recovery instructions. The defendant has filed a motion to compel production of medical records from the plaintiff's family physician that contain a statement by the plaintiff that her back pain began after she picked up her child against the defendant's recovery instructions. The plaintiff has objected, citing the physician-patient privilege recognized under State A law.

Should the court uphold the plaintiff's privilege claim?

一名原告在A州联邦法院对一名被告（脊柱外科医生）提起了多样性管辖诉讼，指控其医疗事故。原告声称，被告在为原告实施手术时，无视既定的医疗准则，导致其持续性且使人衰弱的背部疼痛。被告辩称，原告的背部疼痛是由于其未能遵守康复指示所致。被告已提交一份强制动议，要求原告的家庭医生出示其医疗记录，该记录中包含原告的一项陈述，即她的背部疼痛是在违反被告的康复指示抱起孩子后开始的。原告以A州法律承认的医患特免权为由提出反对。

法院是否应支持原告的特免权主张？
options:
A. No, because the physician-patient privilege is not applicable in federal proceedings.
不应，因为医患特免权不适用于联邦诉讼程序。

B. No, because the plaintiff's physical condition is at issue.
不应，因为原告的身体状况已成为争议点。

C. Yes, because State A recognizes the physician-patient privilege.
应该，因为A州承认医患特免权。

D. Yes, provided the statement was made for the purpose of obtaining medical treatment.
应该，前提是该陈述是为了获得医疗为目的而作出的。
data.explanation:
Physician-patient privilege


ApplicabilityNot recognized by federal common law, which applies in federal-question suits. Typically recognized by state law, which applies in federal diversity suits.
ScopeProtects confidential communications between patient & physician made for purpose of obtaining medical treatment unless:
  • patient's physical condition is at issue
  • communication was part of crime or tort
  • dispute between physician & patient
  • patient contractually waived privilege
Privilege holderPatient holds privilege until his/her death, then privilege terminates.

The physician-patient privilege protects confidential communications between a patient and a physician made for the purpose of obtaining medical treatment. Federal common law, which generally governs privilege claims in federal court, does not recognize this privilege. But state rules on privilege must be applied when a federal suit is based on diversity jurisdiction (as seen here). Since State A recognizes the physician- patient privilege, it could apply in this federal diversity action (Choice A).

However, even when recognized by state law, the physician-patient privilege is inapplicable in the following circumstances:

  • the patient's physical condition is at issue
  • the communication was part of the commission of a crime or tort
  • a dispute exists between the physician and patient or
  • the patient contractually waived the privilege.

Here, the plaintiff's physical condition is at issue because she alleges that her back pain was caused by the defendant's failure to follow established medical guidelines. The statements in the family physician's medical records are relevant to this issue because they suggest that the pain instead resulted from the plaintiff's failure to follow recovery instructions. Therefore, the plaintiff's privilege claim should not be upheld (Choices C & D).

Educational objective: The physician-patient privilege, if recognized by state law, applies in federal diversity suits unless:

  • (1) the patient's physical condition is at issue,
  • (2) the patient-physician communication was part of a crime or tort,
  • (3) there is a dispute between the patient and physician, or
  • (4) the patient contractually waived the privilege.



选项正确率统计：A选项 11%，B选项 57%（正确选项），C选项 13%，D选项 17%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

医患特免权


适用性联邦普通法不予承认，而联邦普通法适用于联邦问题诉讼。通常由州法承认，而州法适用于联邦多样性管辖诉讼。
范围保护患者与医生之间为获得医疗而进行的保密交流，除非：
  • 患者的身体状况成为争议点
  • 该交流是犯罪或侵权行为的一部分
  • 医生与患者之间存在争议
  • 患者通过合同放弃了特免权
特免权持有人患者持有特免权直至其去世，届时特免权终止。

医患特免权保护患者与医生之间为获得医疗目的而进行的保密交流。联邦普通法通常管辖联邦法院的特免权主张，但其不承认此项特免权。但是，当联邦诉讼基于多样性管辖权（如本案所示）时，必须适用州的特免权规则。由于A州承认医患特免权，因此它可以适用于本联邦多样性管辖诉讼 (选项A)。

然而，即使州法承认，医患特免权在以下情况下不适用：

  • 患者的身体状况成为争议点
  • 该交流是实施犯罪或侵权行为的一部分
  • 医生与患者之间存在争议 或
  • 患者通过合同放弃了该特免权。

在本案中，原告的身体状况已成为争议点，因为她声称其背部疼痛是由被告未能遵守既定医疗准则所引起的。其家庭医生的医疗记录中的陈述与此争议点相关，因为这些陈述表明，疼痛反而是由于原告未能遵守康复指示所致。因此，原告的特免权主张不应得到支持 (选项C和D)。

教学目的：医患特免权，如果州法承认，则适用于联邦多样性管辖诉讼，除非：

  • (1) 患者的身体状况成为争议点，
  • (2) 患者与医生的交流是犯罪或侵权行为的一部分，
  • (3) 患者与医生之间存在争议，或
  • (4) 患者通过合同放弃了特免权。

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Privileges & Policy Exclusions

✅ 正确答案：B

不应支持特免权，因为原告的身体状况已成为争议点。

核心考点解析
1. 法律适用规则 (FRE 501):
在联邦法院的多样性管辖 (Diversity Jurisdiction) 案件中，如果州法为案件的判决提供了实质性规则，那么关于特免权 (Privilege) 的问题也必须适用州法。
2. 医患特免权的例外 (The Exception):
虽然许多州承认医患特免权 (Physician-Patient Privilege)，但几乎所有司法管辖区都规定了一个关键例外：
当患者将自己的身体状况置于争议之中 (Physical condition is at issue) 时（例如提起人身伤害或医疗事故诉讼），该特免权即告失效。
逻辑推演

在本案中，原告起诉被告（医生）医疗事故，声称被告导致了她的背部疼痛。

  • 第一步：由于是多样性管辖案件，联邦法院首先会查看A州法律。A州承认医患特免权。
  • 第二步：然而，原告主动提起了关于其“背部疼痛”的诉讼。这意味着她将自己的身体状况变成了案件的核心争议点 (At Issue)。
  • 结论：为了公平起见，原告不能一方面利用身体状况索赔，另一方面又利用特免权隐瞒与该状况相关的证据（即她未遵医嘱抱孩子的记录）。因此，特免权在此情形下不适用。
为什么其他选项是错的？
选项 A 错误

虽然联邦普通法 (Federal Common Law) 确实通常不承认医患特免权，但本案是多样性管辖案件。根据 Fed. R. Evid. 501，法院必须适用州法关于特免权的规定，而不是联邦普通法。

选项 C 错误

虽然A州承认该特免权，但这并不意味着它是绝对的。选项C忽略了关键的“争议点例外” (Patient-Litigant Exception)。

选项 D 错误

即使陈述是为了治疗目的做出的（这是特免权成立的一般条件），但由于原告将身体状况置于争议中，这一例外情况凌驾于一般规则之上。

🎓 MBE 考试通关秘籍

遇到联邦法院的特免权 (Privilege) 题目时，请按以下两步走：

  1. 看管辖权：是联邦问题 (Federal Question) 还是多样性管辖 (Diversity)？
    • 如果是多样性管辖 -> 适用州法。
  2. 找例外：如果是医患特免权，检查原告是否起诉了人身伤害或医疗事故。只要原告说“我受伤了”，通常就意味着放弃了关于该伤情的特免权。

questions.question:
A defendant is charged with conspiracy to sell and distribute cocaine. The defendant's attorney contacted the prosecutor to enter plea negotiations. The prosecutor stated that the defendant would first have to agree that any statements made by the defendant during negotiations could be used to impeach him at trial in the event that a plea bargain could not be reached. After deliberating with his attorney, the defendant agreed to proceed under those terms, but the negotiations were fruitless.
At trial, the defendant testified as to his lack of involvement in the alleged conspiracy. The prosecutor now seeks to cross-examine the defendant about a contrary statement that he made during plea discussions.
Is the proposed cross-examination proper?

choices.a: No, because statements made during plea negotiations cannot be used to impeach a defendant.
choices.b: No, because the protections for statements made during plea negotiations are not subject to waiver.
choices.c: Yes, because the defendant and the prosecutor did not reach a plea bargain.
choices.d: Yes, because the defendant knowingly and voluntarily agreed to waive any protections.

The prosecutor stated that the defendant would first have to agree that any statements made by the defendant during negotiations could be used to impeach him at trial in the event that a plea bargain could not be reached. After deliberating with his attorney, the defendant agreed to proceed under those terms, but the negotiations were fruitless.

At trial, the defendant testified as to his lack of involvement in the alleged conspiracy. The prosecutor now seeks to cross-examine the defendant about a contrary statement that he made during plea discussions.

Is the proposed cross-examination proper?

一名被告被指控共谋销售和分销可卡因。被告的律师联系了检察官进行认罪协商。检察官表示，被告必须首先同意，如果无法达成认罪协议，其在协商期间所作的任何陈述都可以在庭审中用以弹劾他。在与律师商议后，被告同意在这些条款下进行协商，但协商无果而终。

在庭审中，被告作证称其未参与所指控的共谋。检察官现在试图就其在认罪协商期间所作的相反陈述对被告进行交叉询问。

该提议的交叉询问是否适当？
options:
A. No, because statements made during plea negotiations cannot be used to impeach a defendant.
不适当，因为在认罪协商期间所作的陈述不能用以弹劾被告。

B. No, because the protections for statements made during plea negotiations are not subject to waiver.
不适当，因为对认罪协商期间所作陈述的保护不得被放弃。

C. Yes, because the defendant and the prosecutor did not reach a plea bargain.
适当，因为被告和检察官未达成认罪协议。

D. Yes, because the defendant knowingly and voluntarily agreed to waive any protections.
适当，因为被告明知且自愿地同意放弃任何保护。
data.explanation:
The law encourages settlement of disputes and plea-bargaining, so statements made during settlement or plea negotiations are generally not admissible against a defendant who participated in the negotiations or made the plea. However, a defendant may waive this protection - just like any other privilege - if the waiver is made knowingly and voluntarily (Choice B).

Here, the statements that the defendant made during plea negotiations would typically be inadmissible at trial. However, the defendant knowingly and voluntarily waived this protection after deliberating with his attorney. And since the defendant's waiver allows the prosecutor to use any statements made during plea negotiations to impeach the defendant's trial testimony, the prosecutor's proposed cross-examination is proper.

(Choice A) Statements made during plea negotiations generally cannot be used against the defendant for any purpose - including impeachment. However, this protection is lost once it has been waived (as seen here).

(Choice C) The rule excluding statements made during plea negotiations applies even when a plea bargain was not reached. Otherwise, the negotiating parties would be penalized if no agreement was reached, which would discourage the settlement of disputes.

Educational objective: Statements made during settlement or plea negotiations are generally inadmissible against a defendant who participated in the negotiations or made the plea. However, a defendant may waive this protection if the waiver is made knowingly and voluntarily.



选项正确率统计：A选项 27%，B选项 27%，C选项 6%，D选项 39%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

法律鼓励争端和解与认罪协商，因此，在和解或认罪协商期间所作的陈述，通常不得被用作对参与协商或作出认罪的被告不利的证据。但是，被告可以放弃此项保护——如同放弃任何其他特权一样——只要该放弃是明知且自愿的（选项B）。

在本案中，被告在认罪协商期间所作的陈述通常在庭审中是不可采纳的。但是，被告在与律师商议后，明知且自愿地放弃了这项保护。由于被告的放弃行为允许检察官使用其在认罪协商期间所作的任何陈述来弹劾其庭审证词，因此检察官提议的交叉询问是适当的。

（选项A）在认罪协商期间所作的陈述通常不能因任何目的（包括弹劾）而被用作对被告不利的证据。然而，一旦这项保护被放弃（如本案所示），该保护即告失效。

（选项C）排除认罪协商期间所作陈述的规则，即便在未达成认罪协议的情况下也同样适用。否则，如果未能达成协议，协商方将因此受到不利影响，这会阻碍争端的和解。

教学目标：在和解或认罪协商期间所作的陈述，通常不得被用作对参与协商或作出认罪的被告不利的证据。但是，如果被告明知且自愿地作出放弃，则可以放弃此项保护。

References

  • Fed. R. Evid. 410 (prohibited use of pleas, plea discussions, and related statements).
  • United States v. Mezzanatto, 513 U.S. 196, 210 (1995) (upholding a criminal defendant's agreement to waive the protections afforded under the plea-statement rules if the agreement was made knowingly and voluntarily).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Plea Negotiations & Waiver
核心规则：FRE 410

通常情况下，在认罪协商（Plea Negotiations）期间所作的陈述，无论是用于证明被告有罪还是用于弹劾（Impeachment），都是不可采纳的（Inadmissible）。

Public Policy Exclusionary Rule
为什么选 D？(法律推理)
1. 规则的例外：放弃 (Waiver)
虽然联邦证据规则第410条（FRE 410）保护被告在认罪协商中的言论，但美国最高法院在 United States v. Mezzanatto (1995) 一案中确立了重要先例：
被告可以放弃这一保护，只要该放弃是明知且自愿的 (Knowingly and Voluntarily)。
2. 本案事实分析
  • 检察官明确提出了条件：如果协商失败，之前的陈述可用于弹劾。
  • 被告有律师协助（Represented by counsel）。
  • 被告与律师商议后（Deliberated），同意了该条款。
这充分证明了被告的放弃行为是“明知且自愿”的。
✅ 正确答案 D
因为被告明知且自愿地同意放弃任何保护。一旦放弃生效，检察官就可以在交叉询问中使用这些陈述来弹劾被告的庭审证词。
陷阱选项排除
❌ 选项 A (一般规则陷阱)
虽然陈述通常不可采纳，但该选项忽略了“放弃（Waiver）”这一关键例外。MBE常考规则的例外情况。
❌ 选项 B (法律错误)
声称保护“不可放弃”是错误的法律陈述。大多数证据特权和保护都是可以放弃的。
❌ 选项 C (逻辑无关)
未达成协议正是FRE 410通常适用的场景（如果达成了协议，陈述就变成了认罪事实）。但这里能否使用的关键在于“是否放弃了保护”，而不是“是否达成了协议”。
💡 MBE 拿分技巧 当题目涉及“认罪协商陈述” (Plea Negotiation Statements) 时：
  1. 默认原则：不可采纳（无论是作为实质证据还是弹劾证据）。
  2. 唯一例外：检查是否有“放弃协议” (Waiver Agreement)。
  3. 如果有放弃协议，且被告有律师协助，该协议通常有效，陈述可用于弹劾 (Impeachment)。

questions.question:
A defendant has pleaded not guilty to a federal bank robbery charge.
The principal issue at trial is the identity of the robber. The prosecutor has called the defendant's wife to testify to the clothing that the defendant wore as he left their house on the day the bank was robbed, expecting her description to match that of eyewitnesses to the robbery. Both the defendant and his wife have objected to her testifying against the defendant.
Should the wife be required to testify?

choices.a: No, because the defendant has a privilege to prevent his wife from testifying against him in a criminal case.
choices.b: No, because the wife has a privilege not to testify against her husband in a criminal case.
choices.c: Yes, because the spousal testimonial privilege does not apply in criminal cases.
choices.d: Yes, because the wife's viewing of the defendant's clothing was not a confidential communication.

data.questionStem:
Q87144

A defendant has pleaded not guilty to a federal bank robbery charge.

The principal issue at trial is the identity of the robber. The prosecutor has called the defendant's wife to testify to the clothing that the defendant wore as he left their house on the day the bank was robbed, expecting her description to match that of eyewitnesses to the robbery. Both the defendant and his wife have objected to her testifying against the defendant.

Should the wife be required to testify?

一名被告对一项联邦银行抢劫指控作了无罪辩护。

审判中的主要争议点是抢劫者的身份。检察官传唤被告的妻子，让她就银行被抢劫当天被告离家时所穿的衣物作证，期望她的描述与抢劫案目击证人的描述相符。被告和他的妻子都反对她作出对被告不利的证言。

是否应要求该妻子作证？
options:
A. No, because the defendant has a privilege to prevent his wife from testifying against him in a criminal case.
不应要求，因为在刑事案件中，被告享有阻止其妻子作出对他不利证言的特权。

B. No, because the wife has a privilege not to testify against her husband in a criminal case.
不应要求，因为在刑事案件中，妻子享有不作出对其丈夫不利证言的特权。

C. Yes, because the spousal testimonial privilege does not apply in criminal cases.
应要求，因为配偶证言特权不适用于刑事案件。

D. Yes, because the wife's viewing of the defendant's clothing was not a confidential communication.
应要求，因为妻子看到被告的衣物并非一项保密通信。
data.explanation:
Two common law privileges apply to spousal testimony when in federal court:

  • Spousal-communications privilege - protects confidential communications between spouses during the marriage from disclosure in a civil or criminal case, even after the marriage has ended
  • Spousal-immunity (ie, spousal-testimonial) privilege - protects persons in an active marriage from testifying against their spouse in a criminal case about any matters that occurred before or during the marriage (Choice C)


The witness-spouse holds the spousal-immunity privilege and therefore has the unilateral right to either (1) refuse to testify against the other spouse or (2) waive the privilege and testify.

Here, the wife holds the spousal-immunity privilege because she is the testifying spouse. Therefore, the defendant cannot prevent her from testifying against him in his criminal prosecution for bank robbery (Choice A). Nor can the prosecution require her to do so.

(Choice D) The spousal-communications privilege allows either spouse to refuse to disclose or prevent the other from disclosing confidential communications - not mere observations (eg, noticing a spouse's clothing). But the wife need not testify if she asserts the spousal-immunity privilege.

Educational objective:
The spousal-communications privilege protects confidential communications during the marriage from disclosure in a civil or criminal case. In contrast, the spousal-immunity privilege protects persons from being required to testify against their spouse in a criminal case about events that occurred before or during the marriage.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 82%（正确选项），C选项 0%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在联邦法院，有两种普通法上的特权适用于配偶证言：

  • 配偶通讯特权 (Spousal-communications privilege) - 保护婚姻存续期间配偶之间的保密通信，使其在民事或刑事案件中免于被披露，即使在婚姻关系结束后也是如此。
  • 配偶豁免特权 (Spousal-immunity privilege)（即配偶证言特权） - 保护处于有效婚姻关系中的人，使其在刑事案件中免于作出对配偶不利的证言，证言内容可涉及婚前或婚姻存续期间的任何事项 (选项C)。


作为证人的配偶持有配偶豁免特权，因此拥有单方面的权利，可以选择 (1) 拒绝作出对另一方配偶不利的证言，或 (2) 放弃特权并作证。

在本案中，妻子因是作证配偶而持有配偶豁免特权。因此，被告不能阻止她在针对其银行抢劫罪的刑事诉讼中作出对他不利的证言 (选项A)。检察官同样不能强迫她这样做。

(选项D) 配偶通讯特权允许任何一方配偶拒绝披露或阻止另一方披露保密通信——而不仅仅是观察到的事实（例如，注意到配偶的衣物）。但如果妻子主张配偶豁免特权，她就不必作证。

教学目的:
配偶通讯特权 (spousal-communications privilege) 保护婚姻存续期间的保密通信，使其在民事或刑事案件中免于被披露。相比之下，配偶豁免特权 (spousal-immunity privilege) 保护个人在刑事案件中，免于被要求就婚前或婚姻存续期间发生的事件作出对其配偶不利的证言。

References

  • Trammel v. United States, 445 U.S. 40, 53 (1980) (vesting spousal-immunity privilege in the witness-spouse).
  • Fed. R. Evid. 501 (privileges).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：证据法

Spousal Privileges (配偶特权)

核心考点：两种配偶特权

在联邦证据法（Federal Rules of Evidence）下，处理夫妻作证问题时，必须区分两种截然不同的特权。本题考察的是第一种。

特性 配偶豁免特权
(Spousal Immunity)		 配偶通讯特权
(Marital Communications)
适用案件 仅限刑事案件
(Criminal Only)		 民事和刑事案件
(Civil & Criminal)
保护范围 拒绝作证
(Refuse to testify entirely)		 仅限保密通信
(Confidential Communications)
权利持有人
(Holder)		 作证配偶
(Witness-Spouse)		 双方配偶
(Both Spouses)
婚姻状态 审判时必须已婚 通信时必须已婚
(离婚后仍有效)
本题案情分析

1. 案件类型：联邦银行抢劫案（刑事案件）。

2. 争议焦点：检察官试图强迫被告的妻子作证，描述被告当天的衣着。

3. 关键事实：妻子反对作证（Objected to testifying）。

法律适用：
由于是刑事案件，且涉及妻子是否必须出庭作证，适用配偶豁免特权 (Spousal Immunity)。

根据最高法院判例 Trammel v. United States (1980)，在联邦法院，该特权属于作证配偶 (Witness-Spouse)。

结论：
妻子作为特权的持有者，拥有单方面决定权。她可以选择作证，也可以选择拒绝作证。既然她反对作证，法院不能强迫她。

选项深度辨析
正确答案 B

不应要求，因为妻子享有特权。
这是对 Trammel 规则的直接应用。妻子持有特权，她选择行使该特权，因此不能被强迫作证。

错误选项 A

被告享有特权？错。
这是旧的普通法规则。现在的联邦规则是：被告不能阻止愿意作证的配偶作证。特权掌握在证人（妻子）手中，不在被告（丈夫）手中。

错误选项 D

因为不是保密通信？错。
这是一个典型的干扰项。虽然“看到衣物”确实不是“通信”（Communication），但这涉及的是配偶通讯特权的规则。本题中妻子主张的是配偶豁免特权（完全不作证），该特权涵盖所有证词，包括观察到的非通信事实。只要妻子不想说，她就可以不说。

MBE 解题技巧

遇到配偶作证的题目，按以下步骤思考：

  1. 看案件类型：是刑事还是民事？（刑事才涉及豁免特权）。
  2. 看谁想作证：配偶是想帮被告，还是想指证被告？
  3. 看谁持有特权：
    • 如果是豁免特权（刑事+完全不作证）：只有证人配偶说了算。
    • 如果是通讯特权（保密对话）：被告配偶可以阻止证人泄露对话。

questions.question:
In a suit against the defendant, the plaintiff sought to subpoena an audiotape on which the defendant had narrated his version of the dispute for his attorney. Counsel for the defendant moves to quash the subpoena on the ground of privilege.
In which of the following circumstances is the audiotape most likely to be subject to subpoena?

choices.a: The defendant has been deposed and there is good reason to believe that the audiotape may contain inconsistent statements.
choices.b: The defendant is deceased and thus unavailable to give testimony in person.
choices.c: The defendant played the audiotape for his father to get his reactions.
choices.d: The lawsuit involved alleged criminal behavior by the defendant.

data.questionStem:
Q87147

In a suit against the defendant, the plaintiff sought to subpoena an audiotape on which the defendant had narrated his version of the dispute for his attorney. Counsel for the defendant moves to quash the subpoena on the ground of privilege.

In which of the following circumstances is the audiotape most likely to be subject to subpoena?

在一场针对被告的诉讼中，原告试图通过传票获取一盘录音带，该录音带上被告为其律师叙述了他对该争议事件的说法。被告的律师以享有特免权为由，申请撤销该传票。

在下列哪种情形下，该录音带最有可能被传票索取？
options:
A. The defendant has been deposed and there is good reason to believe that the audiotape may contain inconsistent statements.
被告已作证言，且有充分理由相信该录音带可能包含不一致的陈述。

B. The defendant is deceased and thus unavailable to give testimony in person.
被告已故，因此无法亲自出庭作证。

C. The defendant played the audiotape for his father to get his reactions.
被告将录音带播放给其父亲听以获取其反应。

D. The lawsuit involved alleged criminal behavior by the defendant.
该诉讼涉及被告被指控的犯罪行为。
data.explanation:
Waiving attorney-client privilege


WaiverNo waiver
  • voluntarily disclosing information to third party
  • voluntarily giving up privilege (eg, contractually)
  • failing to timely claim privilege (eg, after inadvertent disclosure)
  • failing to object to another's disclosure of confidential information
  • client's death
  • termination of attorney-client relationship
A subpoena can be quashed if it requests information protected from disclosure by a privilege. For example, the attorney-client privilege protects communications that are (1) made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice and/or representation and (2) intended to be and kept confidential. This privilege remains intact unless the client waives it - eg, by voluntarily disclosing the information to a third party.

Here, the defendant's audiotaped version of the dispute is privileged because he gave it to his attorney to obtain legal advice and presumably intended that it be kept confidential. But the defendant would waive this privilege if he voluntarily played the audiotape for his father, thereby disclosing its contents to a third party. And in such circumstances, the audiotape would likely be subject to subpoena.

(Choice A) Good reason to believe that an item might contain statements inconsistent with a witness's sworn testimony is not a basis to overcome a valid claim of privilege.

(Choice B) A defendant's availability has no impact on the ability to subpoena privileged information. Therefore, the defendant's audiotaped narration remains privileged even after his death.

(Choice D) Attorney-client communications made to further an ongoing or future crime are not privileged. But here, the lawsuit concerns a past dispute. So even if the lawsuit involved the defendant's alleged criminal behavior, his audiotaped narration of that dispute for his attorney is privileged.

Educational objective: The attorney-client privilege protects communications made to obtain legal advice and/or representation when they are intended to be and kept confidential. But a client can waive the privilege by voluntarily disclosing protected information to a third party.

选项正确率统计：A选项 6%，B选项 23%，C选项 66%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

放弃律师-委托人特免权


放弃特免权不构成放弃特免权
  • 自愿向第三方披露信息
  • 自愿放弃特免权（例如，通过合同约定）
  • 未能及时主张特免权（例如，在无意中披露后）
  • 未能对他方披露保密信息的行为提出异议
  • 客户死亡
  • 律师-委托人关系的终止
如果传票要求的信息受到特免权的保护而免于披露，则该传票可被撤销。例如，律师-委托人特免权 (attorney-client privilege) 保护那些 (1) 为了获取法律意见和/或代理而进行的并且 (2) 意图保密并保持机密的沟通。除非客户放弃该特免权——例如，通过自愿向第三方披露信息——否则该特免权保持完整。

在本案中，被告关于争议事件的录音带版本享有特免权，因为他是为了获取法律意见而将其提供给律师，并且可以推定其意图是保持该录音带的机密性。但是，如果被告自愿将录音带播放给其父亲听，从而将其内容披露给第三方，那么他就放弃了这项特免权。在这种情况下，该录音带很可能会被传票索取。

(选项A) 有充分理由相信某项物品可能包含与证人宣誓证词不一致的陈述，这并不构成推翻有效特免权主张的依据。

(选项B) 被告是否可出庭作证对于能否通过传票获取享有特免权的信息没有影响。因此，即使在被告去世后，其录音叙述仍然享有特免权。

(选项D) 为助长正在进行中或未来的犯罪而进行的律师-客户沟通不享有特免权。但在本案中，该诉讼涉及的是一个过去的争议。因此，即使该诉讼涉及被告被指控的犯罪行为，他为律师录制的关于该争议的叙述也享有特免权。

教学目的：律师-委托人特免权保护那些为了获取法律意见和/或代理而进行、且意图保密并保持机密的沟通。但客户可以通过自愿向第三方披露受保护的信息来放弃该特免权。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 501 (federal common law privileges).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Privileges
✅ 正确答案：选项 C

核心理由：向第三方（父亲）披露特权通信内容，构成了对律师-委托人特免权（Attorney-Client Privilege）的自愿放弃（Waiver）。

考点核心：特免权的保密性

律师-委托人特免权 (Attorney-Client Privilege) 的存在必须同时满足以下条件：

  • 沟通发生在律师与客户之间；
  • 目的是为了寻求法律建议 (Legal Advice)；
  • 意图保密 (Intended to be Confidential)。

一旦客户自愿将受保护的沟通内容披露给任何第三方（Third Party），法律通常视为客户不再需要保密，特免权即告放弃 (Waived)。

在本题中，被告将录音带放给父亲听，父亲是第三方，这一行为破坏了保密性，导致特免权丧失，因此该录音带可以被传票索取。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
选项 A：不一致的陈述 (Inconsistent Statements)

错误原因：这是 MBE 常见的陷阱，混淆了特免权与“律师工作成果”(Work Product)。

虽然对于普通的工作成果，如果有“实质性需求”(Substantial Need)，可能被要求披露。但律师-委托人特免权是绝对的（除非有例外或放弃）。仅仅为了弹劾证人（Impeachment）或发现不一致陈述，不足以刺破这一特免权。

选项 B：被告已故 (Deceased)

错误原因：根据联邦普通法（及最高法院判例 Swidler & Berlin v. United States），律师-委托人特免权在客户死亡后仍然存续。死亡本身并不构成特免权的放弃。

选项 D：涉及犯罪行为 (Criminal Behavior)

错误原因：这里涉及犯罪-欺诈例外 (Crime-Fraud Exception) 的适用范围。

该例外仅适用于客户寻求律师帮助以实施未来的犯罪或欺诈。如果是针对过去已发生的行为寻求辩护（这是刑事辩护的本质），该沟通受到绝对保护。本题中，被告是在叙述过去的争议，因此享有特免权。

💡 MBE 破题技巧

在处理 Privilege 问题时，按以下步骤思考：

  1. 是否存在特免权？（本题中：录音带是给律师的，目的是法律咨询，初始状态有特免权。）
  2. 是否发生了放弃 (Waiver)？（这是最常见的考点。找有没有“大嘴巴”客户把秘密告诉了局外人。）
  3. 是否有例外 (Exception)？（如未来的犯罪计划、共同委托人纠纷等。）

记住：保密性 (Confidentiality) 是特免权的生命线，一旦泄露给第三方，特免权通常就“死”了。

A corporation's in-house legal department initiated an internal investigation after being informed of potential misconduct involving payments made to government officials. As part of the investigation, an attorney from the legal department interviewed every member of the corporation's accounting department responsible for making such payments. The attorney took detailed notes of the accountants' statements and her corresponding mental impressions. Upon completing the internal investigation, the corporation's legal department informed the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) of the payments. The IRS then opened an investigation into the legality of such payments and now seeks the production of the interview notes. The corporation's legal counsel has objected on the ground of privilege.
Which portion of the notes, if any, is likely privileged?

choices.a: All of the notes are privileged.
choices.b: Only the portion concerning the accountants' statements is privileged.
choices.c: Only the portion containing the attorney's mental impressions is privileged.
choices.d: None of the notes are privileged, provided that the IRS can show a substantial need for the notes and cannot otherwise obtain them without undue hardship.

一家公司的内部法务部门在得知可能存在涉及向政府官员付款的不当行为后，启动了一项内部调查。作为调查的一部分，法务部门的一名律师访谈了公司会计部门中负责此类付款的每一位成员。该律师详细记录了会计师们的陈述以及她相应的心理印象。在完成内部调查后，公司的法务部门将付款情况告知了美国国家税务局（Internal Revenue Service, IRS）。IRS 随后对这些付款的合法性展开调查，并现在要求出示这些访谈笔记。公司的法律顾问以特免权为由提出了异议。

这些笔记的哪一部分（若有）可能享有特免权？
options:
A. All of the notes are privileged.
所有笔记都享有特免权。

B. Only the portion concerning the accountants' statements is privileged.
只有涉及会计师陈述的部分享有特免权。

C. Only the portion containing the attorney's mental impressions is privileged.
只有包含律师心理印象的部分享有特免权。

D. None of the notes are privileged, provided that the IRS can show a substantial need for the notes and cannot otherwise obtain them without undue hardship.
所有笔记都不享有特免权，前提是 IRS 能够证明对这些笔记有重大需求，并且无法在不承受过度困难的情况下通过其他方式获取。
data.explanation:
Attorney-client privilege for corporate clients


Control-group test
(minority state view)		Federal standard
(& majority state view)
Confidential communication† privileged if it:

was received from employee in position of control or who takes substantial part in decision- making		Confidential communication† privileged if it:

was made by any employee for express purpose of securing legal advice for corporation and related to employee's specific corporate duties
†A communication is confidential if it was intended to be & was kept confidential.

The attorney-client privilege protects confidential communications between an attorney and a client made for the purpose of seeking legal advice or representation. When an attorney represents a corporate client, some states limit this privilege to communications received from employees in a position of control or who take a substantial part in decision-making (ie, the "control group"). However, federal law extends this privilege to communications from non-control-group employees if the communication concerned matters within the employee's corporate duties and was made for the purpose of securing legal advice for the corporation.

Here, the attorney's notes include statements made by employees in the corporation's accounting department. Although these employees may not be part of the "control group," the statements concern payments made to government officials - a matter that likely is within the accountants' corporate duties. And since the accountants presumably knew that they were being interviewed so that the corporation could obtain legal advice about those payments, the communications contained in the notes are likely privileged (Choices C & D).

However, the attorney's mental impressions are not covered by the attorney-client privilege; they are protected by the attorney work-product privilege. Under this doctrine, ordinary work product (eg, witness statements) is discoverable if the requesting party shows a substantial need for the information and cannot otherwise obtain it without undue hardship. But opinion work product (eg, mental impressions) is discoverable only in rare instances. Therefore, the portion containing the attorney's mental impressions is likely privileged too (Choices B & D).

Educational objective: For corporate clients, federal law extends the attorney-client privilege to confidential communications from any employee that (1) concerned matters within the employee's corporate duties and (2) were made for the purpose of securing legal advice for the corporation.

选项正确率统计：A选项 45%（正确选项），B选项 2%，C选项 37%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

公司客户的律师-当事人特免权


控制集团测试
（少数州观点）		联邦标准
（及多数州观点）
保密通信†在以下情况下享有特免权：

从处于控制地位或在决策中起重要作用的员工处获得		保密通信†在以下情况下享有特免权：

由任何员工为了给公司获取法律建议的明确目的而作出，并且与该员工特定的公司职责相关
†一项通信，如果其意图是保密的并且一直保持保密，则该通信是保密的。

律师-当事人特免权（attorney-client privilege）保护律师与当事人之间为寻求法律建议或代理而进行的保密通信。当律师代理公司客户时，一些州将此特免权限制在从处于控制地位或在决策中起重要作用的员工（即“控制集团”）处获得的通信。然而，联邦法律将此特免权扩展至来自非控制集团员工的通信，前提是该通信涉及员工公司职责范围内的事项，并且是为了替公司获取法律建议而作出的。

在本案中，律师的笔记包含了公司会计部门员工的陈述。尽管这些员工可能不属于“控制集团”，但其陈述涉及向政府官员付款——此事很可能属于会计师的公司职责范围。并且，由于可以推断会计师们知道他们接受访谈是为了让公司能就这些付款获得法律建议，因此笔记中包含的通信可能享有特免权（选项 C 和 D）。

然而，律师的心理印象不属于律师-当事人特免权的保护范围；它们受到律师工作成果特免权（attorney work-product privilege）的保护。根据该原则，普通工作成果（例如，证人陈述）在请求方证明对信息有重大需求且无法在不承受过度困难的情况下通过其他方式获取时，是可以被取证的。但意见性工作成果（例如，心理印象）仅在极少数情况下才可被取证。因此，包含律师心理印象的部分也可能享有特免权（选项 B 和 D）。

教学目标：对于公司客户，联邦法律将律师-当事人特免权延伸至任何员工的保密通信，只要该通信 (1) 涉及该员工公司职责范围内的事项，并且 (2) 是为了给公司获取法律建议而作出的。

References

Upjohn Co. v. United States, 449 U.S. 383, 394 (1981) (extending attorney-client privilege to employee communications concerning matters within the employee's corporate duties made to obtain legal advice for the corporation).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Civil Procedure
✅ 正确答案：A (All of the notes)

本题考察的是公司背景下的律师-当事人特免权 (Attorney-Client Privilege) 和律师工作成果原则 (Work Product Doctrine) 的交叉应用。

考点一：Upjohn 原则

公司特免权的范围

在联邦法律下（本题涉及 IRS 调查，适用联邦法），判断公司员工与公司律师的沟通是否享有特免权，适用 Upjohn Doctrine。

只要满足以下条件，即便是低层员工（非管理层）的沟通也受保护：

  • 沟通是为了让公司获得法律建议 (Legal Advice)；
  • 沟通内容属于该员工的公司职责范围 (Scope of Corporate Duties)；
  • 沟通是保密的。
📝 案情应用：
律师访谈了会计部门员工。虽然他们不是高管（非 Control Group），但付款属于他们的职责范围，且访谈是为了应对法律合规问题。因此，会计师的陈述享有律师-当事人特免权。
考点二：工作成果原则

Work Product Doctrine

律师为诉讼或调查准备的材料受保护，分为两类：

  1. 普通工作成果 (Ordinary Work Product)：如事实记录。若对方证明有“重大需求”且“难以获取”，可能被披露。
  2. 意见工作成果 (Opinion Work Product)：包含律师的心理印象、策略、结论。享有近乎绝对的保护，极难被披露。
📝 案情应用：
律师的笔记中包含了“心理印象” (Mental Impressions)。这部分属于核心工作成果，享有最高等级的保护。
为什么选 A？

笔记由两部分组成：

  • 会计师的陈述：受 Attorney-Client Privilege 保护（因为符合 Upjohn 标准）。特免权是绝对的，除非被放弃。
  • 律师的心理印象：受 Opinion Work Product 保护。

因此，笔记的全部内容（All of the notes）都受到保护，IRS 无法获取。

⚠️ 考场陷阱：选项 D

选项 D 提到了“重大需求” (Substantial Need) 和“过度困难” (Undue Hardship)。

这是针对普通工作成果（如单纯的证人名单或非特免权的事实收集）的例外规则。但是：

  1. 它不能攻破律师-当事人特免权（Privilege）。
  2. 它几乎不能攻破包含心理印象的意见工作成果。

由于本题中的笔记既包含特免权内容，又包含心理印象，仅凭“重大需求”是无法获取的。

一名男子因威胁美国总统而在联邦法院被起诉。该男子是一家私立精神病院的自愿入院患者，在总统来到该市前不久，他告诉一名护士，他计划枪杀总统。护士将此威胁报告给了联邦调查局（FBI）特工。该男子提出动议，要求禁止该护士作证。

该男子的动议是否可能被批准？
options:
A. No, because the man had not been committed involuntarily by court order.
不会，因为该男子并非由法院命令非自愿收治。

B. No, because the statement was not within any privilege.
不会，因为该陈述不在任何特免权的保护范围内。

C. Yes, because the nurse violated a confidence in reporting the statement.
会，因为护士报告该陈述违反了保密义务。

D. Yes, because the statement was made in a medical setting.
会，因为该陈述是在医疗环境中作出的。
data.explanation:
Psychotherapist-patient privilege


Confidential communication between psychotherapist/social worker & patient protected if made during the course of diagnosis or treatment of mental/emotional condition unless:
  • patient's mental condition at issue
  • communication made during court-ordered mental exam or
  • communication introduced at involuntary-commitment proceeding
Patient holds privilege & psychotherapist must assert in patient's absence
A privilege protects confidential communications from disclosure, discovery, or admission in a legal proceeding. Under Federal Rule of Evidence 501, claims of privilege are generally governed by the common law.† For instance, the common law psychotherapist-patient privilege protects confidential communications between a psychotherapist (ie, a psychologist or psychiatrist) or social worker and a patient made during the course of treatment or diagnosis.

Here, the psychotherapist-patient privilege is implicated because the man is a patient in a psychiatric hospital. But his statement - ie, the threat against the President - does not fall within that privilege because it was not made to a psychotherapist or social worker OR during treatment or diagnosis. Therefore, though the nurse may have violated a confidence in reporting the statement, the man's motion is unlikely to be granted (Choice C).

†Common law governs claims of privilege in federal court unless (1) the Constitution, a federal statute, or a rule provides otherwise or (2) the suit is based on diversity jurisdiction so state rules on privilege must be applied.

(Choice A) Involuntary commitment is not required to protect a confidential communication under the psychotherapist-patient privilege.

(Choice D) The statement was made in a medical setting. But this alone is not a basis to prevent the nurse from testifying about the man's threat against the President.

Educational objective: The psychotherapist-patient privilege applies to confidential communications (1) between a psychotherapist/social worker and a patient (2) made during the course of treatment or diagnosis.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 92%（正确选项），C选项 4%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

心理治疗师-患者特免权 (Psychotherapist-patient privilege)


在精神/情绪状况的诊断或治疗过程中，心理治疗师/社会工作者与患者之间的保密通讯受特免权保护，除非：
  • 患者的精神状况成为争议点
  • 通讯是在法院命令的精神检查中作出的或
  • 通讯在非自愿收治程序中被引用
患者持有特免权，且心理治疗师必须在患者缺席时主张此权利
特免权（privilege）保护保密通讯在法律程序中免于披露、证据开示或采纳。根据《联邦证据规则》第501条 (Federal Rule of Evidence 501)，特免权的主张通常受普通法管辖。† 例如，普通法中的心理治疗师-患者特免权 (psychotherapist-patient privilege) 保护在治疗或诊断过程中，心理治疗师（即心理学家或精神科医生）或社会工作者与患者之间的保密通讯。

在本案中，由于该男子是精神病院的患者，因此涉及到心理治疗师-患者特免权。但他的陈述——即对总统的威胁——不属于该特免权的保护范围，因为它既不是向心理治疗师或社会工作者作出的，也不是在治疗或诊断过程中作出的。因此，尽管护士报告该陈述可能违反了保密义务，但该男子的动议不太可能被批准（选项C）。

†在联邦法院，特免权主张受普通法管辖，除非（1）宪法、联邦法规或某项规则另有规定，或（2）该诉讼基于多元管辖权 (diversity jurisdiction)，因此必须适用州的特免权规则。

（选项A）根据心理治疗师-患者特免权，保护保密通讯并不要求非自愿收治。

（选项D）该陈述确实是在医疗环境中作出的。但这本身并不能成为阻止护士就该男子威胁总统一事作证的依据。

教学目标：心理治疗师-患者特免权适用于（1）心理治疗师/社会工作者与患者之间，（2）在治疗或诊断过程中作出的保密通讯。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 501 (privilege in general).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence: Privileges (证据法：特免权)
正确答案：B

不会，因为该陈述不在任何特免权的保护范围内。
(No, because the statement was not within any privilege.)

⚖️ 法律依据与推理

本题的核心考点在于联邦法院中特免权（Privilege）的适用范围，特别是涉及医疗环境时的区分。

1. 联邦证据规则第501条 (FRE 501)

在联邦刑事案件（如本案中威胁总统）中，特免权由联邦普通法 (Federal Common Law) 管辖，而不是州法律。

2. 心理治疗师-患者特免权
(Psychotherapist-Patient Privilege)

根据最高法院判例 Jaffee v. Redmond，联邦法律承认心理治疗师与患者之间的特免权。但这有严格的限制：

  • 主体限制：必须是向持照的心理治疗师、心理学家或临床社会工作者 (LCSW) 作出的。
  • 目的限制：必须是为了诊断或治疗 (Diagnosis or Treatment) 目的。
3. 为什么本案不适用？

虽然该男子在精神病院，但他的陈述存在两个致命缺陷，使其无法获得保护：

  • 对象错误：他是对护士 (Nurse) 说的，而不是心理治疗师。联邦普通法通常不承认独立的“护士-患者”特免权，除非护士是作为治疗师的代理人协助治疗。
  • 内容性质：“计划枪杀总统”通常被视为犯罪威胁，而非为了医疗诊断或治疗的保密沟通。
❌ 陷阱选项分析

选项 A (非自愿收治)：
这是干扰项。特免权的适用取决于沟通的保密性和治疗目的，与患者是自愿入院还是强制入院无关。

选项 C (违反保密义务)：
这是 MBE 常见的混淆点。保密义务 (Confidentiality) 是职业道德概念，而特免权 (Privilege) 是证据法概念。护士可能违反了职业道德（尽管报告严重威胁通常是道德允许的），但这并不意味着该证词在法庭上不可采信 (Inadmissible)。

选项 D (医疗环境)：
这是最大的陷阱。许多州承认广泛的“医患特免权” (Physician-Patient Privilege)，但在联邦刑事案件中，普通法不承认一般的医患特免权。仅仅因为在医院说话，并不自动产生特免权。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：

遇到联邦法院的特免权题目时，请记住：
1. 联邦刑事案件不适用州特免权法。
2. 联邦普通法没有通用的“医生-患者”特免权（仅限于心理治疗）。
3. 区分“道德上的保密”与“法律上的特免权”。

法院应如何就业主的特免权主张作出裁定？
options:
A. Both sets of emails are privileged.

B. Only the first set of emails is privileged, because the second set of emails does not provide legal advice.

C. Only the second set of emails email is privileged, because the first set of emails does not include the attorney's response.
只有第二组电子邮件享有特免权，因为第一组电子邮件不包含律师的回复。

D. Neither set of emails is privileged, because both tend to establish willful trading on the plaintiff's mark.

data.explanation:
Attorney-client privileged communications


(FRE 502)

Any communication between attorney & client:

PrivilegedNot privileged
made to obtain legal advice/representation and intended to be & kept confidentialPurely factual information Client's identity (generally) Existence of attorney-client relationship Client's legal fees & other incidentals Attorney's fee records Business advice or opinions

FRE = Federal Rule of Evidence.



The

attorney-client privilege protects confidential communications † that are made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice/representation. This allows the client to freely and frankly communicate with an attorney (and vice versa). As a result, the first set of emails in which the owner sought legal advice regarding the eatery's potential liability for trademark infringement is protected by this privilege (Choice C).



In contrast, attorney-client communications that are made for some other purpose are not protected by this privilege. This includes communications in which the client solicits, or the attorney offers, mere business advice or opinions. Therefore, the second set of emails about the eatery's business potential - which solicited business advice rather than legal advice - is not protected by this privilege (Choice A).



†Communications are confidential if they were intended to be and kept private.



(Choice D) The fact that both sets of emails tend to establish that the owner willfully traded on the plaintiff's mark has no bearing on the applicability of the attorney-client privilege. Instead, this privilege turns on whether the communication was made to obtain legal advice/representation.



Educational objective: The attorney-client privilege protects confidential communications that are made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice/representation. But communications made for other purposes - including rendering business advice or opinions - are not protected.

律师-当事人特免沟通


(FRE 502)

任何律师与当事人之间的沟通：

享有特免权不享有特免权
为获取法律意见/代理而作出并且意图保密并保持机密的沟通纯粹的事实信息
当事人的身份（通常情况下）
律师-当事人关系的存在
当事人的律师费及其他杂费
律师的费用记录
商业建议或意见

FRE = 《联邦证据规则》(Federal Rule of Evidence)。



律师-当事人特免权保护为获取法律意见/代理之目的而进行的保密沟通†。这使得当事人可以自由、坦诚地与律师沟通（反之亦然）。因此，业主在第一组电子邮件中就餐馆潜在的商标侵权责任征求法律意见，该组邮件受此特免权保护（选项C）。



相比之下，为其他目的而进行的律师-当事人沟通则不受此特免权保护。这包括当事人征求或律师仅提供商业建议或意见的沟通。因此，关于餐馆商业潜力的第二组电子邮件——其征求的是商业建议而非法律意见——不受此特免权保护（选项A）。



†如果沟通意图保密并保持私密，则该沟通是保密的。



（选项D）两组电子邮件是否倾向于证实业主故意利用原告的商标，这一事实与律师-当事人特免权的适用性无关。相反，此特免权取决于沟通是否是为了获取法律意见/代理。



教学目标：律师-当事人特免权保护为获取法律意见/代理之目的而进行的保密沟通。但为其他目的（包括提供商业建议或意见）而进行的沟通则不受保护。



References

Fed. R. Evid. 501 (federal common law privileges).

MBE 考点解析

Evidence / Privileges

正确答案：B

第一组邮件享有特免权，第二组不享有。

⚖️ 核心考点：律师-当事人特免权
💡 Attorney-Client Privilege (律师-当事人特免权)

根据联邦普通法（Federal Common Law），该特免权保护以下沟通：

  • 机密沟通 (Confidential Communications)
  • 发生在律师与当事人之间
  • 目的是为了获取或提供法律意见 (Legal Advice)
🔍 深度解析

1. 第一组邮件：法律意见 (Legal Advice)

业主指出标志相似并询问“潜在的法律责任”。这是典型的寻求法律专业判断的行为。

  • 关键点：即使律师从未回复，特免权依然存在。特免权保护的是当事人为了寻求法律帮助而进行的坦诚披露。只要当事人是基于寻求法律代理或建议的目的发送邮件，该沟通即受保护。

2. 第二组邮件：商业建议 (Business Advice)

业主和律师讨论的是“商业潜力” (Business potential)。

  • 关键点：律师经常身兼多职（如商业顾问）。当沟通的内容纯粹关于商业策略、市场前景或非法律事务时，不享有律师-当事人特免权。
  • 法院会审查沟通的主要目的 (Primary Purpose)。如果目的是商业决策而非法律合规，则必须披露。
🚫 为什么其他选项是错的？
关于选项 D (陷阱选项)：
选项 D 认为邮件不享有特免权，因为它们证实了“故意侵权”。

解析：这是对特免权逻辑的误解。特免权的核心目的正是为了让当事人能安全地向律师承认过去的错误或潜在的责任，以便获得辩护。

虽然存在犯罪-欺诈例外 (Crime-Fraud Exception)，但它仅适用于寻求建议以实施未来的犯罪或欺诈。本题中，业主是在咨询已发生行为的法律后果，这正是特免权保护的核心领域。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 证据法题目中，遇到涉及律师的沟通时，请立即进行两步测试：

  1. 内容测试：他们在谈论什么？是法律责任/诉讼策略（受保护），还是纯粹的商业/生意经（不受保护）？
  2. 保密性测试：是否有无关的第三方在场？（本题未涉及，但常考）。

记住：律师的身份不是“保护伞”，沟通的目的才是关键。

At the start of the trial of a defendant and a codefendant for robbery, the codefendant and her attorney offered to give the prosecutor information about facts that would strengthen the prosecutor's case against the defendant in exchange for leniency toward the codefendant. The prosecutor refused the offer. Shortly thereafter, the codefendant committed suicide.
During the defendant's trial, the prosecutor called the codefendant's attorney and asked him to relate the information that the codefendant had revealed to the attorney.
Is the attorney's testimony admissible?

choices.a: No, because the codefendant's communications are protected by the attorney-client privilege.
choices.b: No, because the plea discussion was initiated by the codefendant rather than by the prosecutor.
choices.c: Yes, because the codefendant intended to disclose the information.
choices.d: Yes, because the information the codefendant gave to her attorney revealing her knowledge of the crime would be a statement against the codefendant's penal interest.

在对一名被告和一名同案被告的抢劫罪审判开始时，该同案被告及其律师向检察官提出，愿意提供有关事实的信息以加强检察官对该被告的指控，以此换取对该同案被告的宽大处理。检察官拒绝了这一提议。此后不久，该同案被告自杀身亡。

在该被告的审判期间，检察官传唤了同案被告的律师，并要求他陈述该同案被告曾向其披露的信息。

该律师的证言是否可被采纳？
options:
A. No, because the codefendant's communications are protected by the attorney-client privilege.
否，因为同案被告的沟通内容受律师-当事人特免权的保护。

B. No, because the plea discussion was initiated by the codefendant rather than by the prosecutor.
否，因为认罪协商是由同案被告而非检察官发起的。

C. Yes, because the codefendant intended to disclose the information.
是，因为同案被告曾意图披露该信息。

D. Yes, because the information the codefendant gave to her attorney revealing her knowledge of the crime would be a statement against the codefendant's penal interest.
是，因为同案被告提供给其律师的、揭示其对罪行知情的信息，将构成一项对该同案被告刑事利益不利的陈述。
data.explanation:
Common law privileges protect confidential communications from disclosure, discovery, or admission in federal legal proceedings.† One such privilege applies to attorney-client communications that are
  • made for the purpose of obtaining legal advice and/or representation and
  • intended to be and kept confidential.


As the holder of the attorney-client privilege, the client can refuse to disclose confidential communications to third parties and prevent the attorney from doing so. The privilege remains in effect even after the attorney-client relationship terminates or the client dies (as seen here). However, the client may waive the privilege by:

  • voluntarily disclosing the information to a third party
  • voluntarily giving up the privilege (eg, contractually)
  • failing to timely claim the privilege (eg, after inadvertent disclosure) or
  • failing to object to another's disclosure of confidential information (eg, at trial).


Here, the codefendant shared facts about the robbery with her attorney. That communication was protected by the attorney-client privilege because it was made to obtain legal representation and was, at least initially, intended to be kept confidential. And though the codefendant offered those facts to the prosecutor during a plea discussion, she did not actually disclose them. Her mere offer - regardless of who initiated the discussion - did not waive the privilege, so the attorney's testimony about those facts is inadmissible (Choices B & C).

†Federal courts apply common law privileges except in diversity cases, where state privilege rules apply.

(Choice D) A statement against interest is not barred by the rule against hearsay when the declarant is unavailable (eg, deceased). Here, the deceased codefendant's information was likely against her penal interest because it revealed her knowledge of the crime. But it remains barred by the attorney-client privilege.

Educational objective: Attorney-client communications are privileged when
  • made to obtain legal advice and/or representation and
  • intended to be and kept confidential.
Merely offering to share the privileged information does not waive the privilege.



选项正确率统计：A选项 83%（正确选项），B选项 4%，C选项 4%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在联邦法律程序中，普通法上的特免权保护保密通信免于被披露、证据开示或采纳。† 其中一项特免权适用于律师-当事人之间的沟通，该沟通需满足以下条件：
  • 为了获取法律咨询和/或代理而进行，并且
  • 意图保密且保持保密。


作为律师-当事人特免权的持有者，当事人可以拒绝向第三方披露保密通信，并可阻止其律师这样做。即使在律师-当事人关系终止或当事人死亡（如本案所示）之后，该特免权仍然有效。然而，当事人可以通过以下方式放弃该特免权：

  • 自愿将信息披露给第三方
  • 自愿放弃该特免权（例如，通过合同约定）
  • 未能及时主张该特免权（例如，在无意中披露后）或
  • 未能在他人披露保密信息时（例如，在审判中）提出异议。


在本案中，同案被告与她的律师分享了关于抢劫罪的事实。该沟通受到律师-当事人特免权的保护，因为它是为了获取法律代理而进行的，并且至少在最初是意图保密的。尽管该同案被告在认罪协商中向检察官提议提供这些事实，但她并未实际披露它们。她仅仅是提出要约——无论该协商由谁发起——并不构成对特免权的放弃，因此律师关于这些事实的证言是不可采纳的（选项B和C）。

†联邦法院适用普通法特免权，但在多样性管辖权的案件中除外，此类案件适用州的特免权规则。

（选项D）当陈述人无法出庭作证（例如，已故）时，其“不利于己的陈述”不受“反对传闻证据规则”的禁止。在本案中，已故同案被告的信息很可能对她的刑事利益不利，因为它揭示了她对罪行的知情。但该信息仍然受到律师-当事人特免权的禁止。

教学目标：律师-当事人之间的沟通在以下情况下享有特免权：
  • 为了获取法律咨询和/或代理而进行，并且
  • 意图保密且保持保密。
仅仅提议分享享有特免权的信息，并不构成对该特免权的放弃。

References

Fed. R. Evid. 501 (federal common law privileges).

data.htmlContent:
Evidence / Privileges

MBE 考点解析：律师-当事人特免权与死亡

本题考察的是证据法中关于律师-当事人特免权（Attorney-Client Privilege）的持久性及其放弃（Waiver）的条件。

核心法则 (The Rule):
律师-当事人特免权保护当事人为了寻求法律建议而进行的保密沟通。该特免权具有极强的持久性：
  • 死后依然有效：特免权在当事人死亡后仍然存在（Survives the death of the client）。
  • 放弃需实际披露：仅有披露的意图（Intent）或提议（Offer），若未实际发生披露，不构成对特免权的放弃。

1. 为什么选 A？(正确答案解析)

本案中，同案被告（Codefendant）向其律师透露了关于抢劫的事实。这是典型的为了获取法律代理而进行的保密沟通，因此受到律师-当事人特免权的保护。

关键事实分析：

  • 提议 vs. 实际披露：同案被告曾提议向检察官披露这些信息以换取宽大处理，但检察官拒绝了。这意味着保密信息从未真正流出律师与当事人的圈子。
  • 死亡的影响：虽然同案被告自杀身亡，但根据联邦普通法（Common Law），特免权并不随当事人死亡而终止。

因此，律师不能被迫作证，该证言不可采纳。

⚠️ 常见陷阱：传闻证据例外 (Choice D)

很多考生会误选 D，认为这是“不利于己的陈述”（Statement Against Interest）。

逻辑漏洞：

虽然该陈述确实符合传闻证据例外（Hearsay Exception）的定义（因为陈述人已故且陈述对其不利），但特免权（Privilege）的效力高于传闻规则。

即使一句话符合传闻例外，如果它受到特免权保护，它依然是不可采纳的。特免权是证据进入法庭的“绝对门槛”。

2. 为什么其他选项错误？

  • 选项 B (谁发起的协商)： 错误。无论认罪协商（Plea Discussion）是由谁发起的，都不影响特免权的分析。此外，Fed. R. Evid. 410 通常禁止采纳认罪协商中的陈述，但这只是额外的保护层，核心障碍依然是特免权未被放弃。
  • 选项 C (披露的意图)： 错误。仅仅“打算”披露（Intended to disclose）并不构成放弃（Waiver）。放弃特免权通常需要自愿的、实际的向第三方披露保密内容。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip):
在 MBE 证据法题目中，按照以下顺序思考：
  1. 相关性 (Relevance)： 证据是否相关？
  2. 特免权 (Privilege)： 是否受特免权保护？（如果是，直接排除，无需讨论传闻）。
  3. 传闻 (Hearsay)： 如果没有特免权，是否属于传闻？是否有例外？
切记：Privilege > Hearsay Exceptions。
Reference: Fed. R. Evid. 501; Swidler & Berlin v. United States (1998).

A woman entered a guilty plea to a charge of embezzlement. Her attorney hired a retired probation officer as a consultant to gather information for the preparation of a sentencing plan for the woman that would avoid jail. For that purpose, the consultant interviewed the woman for three hours.
Thereafter, the prosecution undertook an investigation of the woman's possible involvement in other acts of embezzlement. The consultant was subpoenaed to testify before a grand jury. The consultant refused to answer any questions concerning his conversation with the woman.
The prosecution has moved for an order requiring the consultant to answer those questions.
How should the court rule on the prosecution's motion?

choices.b: Deny the motion on the basis of the attorney-client privilege.
choices.c: Grant the motion because exclusionary evidentiary rules do not apply in grand jury proceedings.
choices.d: Grant the motion because the consultant is not an attorney.
